title: Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)
description: <h1><strong>Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)</strong></h1> <p>Are you a hands-on engineer who loves zero-to-one challenges? Do you want to build systems with real context and memory that do more than reason, use tools, and drive actual business outcomes?&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <p>GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains, designed to give GTM teams and AI agents a shared business brain. Business context usually gets fragmented across CRMs, documents, dashboards, and people's heads. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack.</p> <h2><strong>About GrowthBricks</strong></h2> <p>GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.</p> <p>It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.</p> <p>GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero.</p> <p>You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer.</p> <p>The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes.</p> <p>You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll work on</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design the core architecture: business context, agents, tools, integrations, and feedback loops.</li> <li>Build agentic workflows that can reason over company context and act across CRM, sales, marketing, and product systems.</li> <li>Build context extractors from GTM team artifacts like sales calls, emails, internal documents, CRM state, marketing campaigns, etc.</li> <li>Work on prompting, context management, memory, tool use, and orchestration.</li> <li>Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.</li> <li>Decide where to use MCP, APIs, frameworks, or third-party tools and where a custom solution is worth it.</li> <li>Prototype fast, discard weak ideas, and turn the useful ones into product primitives.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We expect that you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Are a strong hands-on engineer who enjoys zero-to-one work.</li> <li>Have built with LLMs, agents, or agentic workflows used by real people, and improved them based on failures, evaluations, and user feedback.</li> <li>Understand how context, prompting, tools, and agent behavior fit together.</li> <li>Can design backend systems, APIs, data models, and integrations.</li> <li>Are comfortable making decisions before all the answers are known.</li> <li>Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We’re especially interested if you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Have worked in solution engineering, sales engineering, pre-sales, or built software for GTM teams.</li> <li>Understand the modern GTM stack: CRM, enrichment, outbound, automation, and product signals.</li> <li>Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.</li> <li>Have owned a technical product from a blank repo to something people actually used.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>GTM experience is not mandatory, but if you already understand how sales and marketing teams work, that is a strong advantage.</p> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A competitive salary and strong benefits package.</li> <li>The runway and resources of an established company, with startup-level autonomy.</li> <li>A founding role with direct influence over both product and architecture.</li> <li>Real users and real workflows from day one.</li> <li>Freedom to choose the stack, tools, and technical approach.</li> <li>A chance to help define what an agent-native GTM product should look like.</li> </ul> <p><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-IM</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.jetbrains.com/legal/docs/privacy/privacy-recruitment/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

116, 204);"><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></span></p> <ul> <li> <p>Develop, implement, and continuously improve a robust&nbsp;Software Product Assurance (PA) programme, reporting directly to the&nbsp;Product Assurance Manager.</p> </li> <li> <p>Take&nbsp;end-to-end ownership of Software Product Assurance&nbsp;across both&nbsp;flight and ground software&nbsp;for our satellite raw.description:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have...

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get

- Competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity

- Remote in EMEA, with hubs in New York, Toronto and Barcelona

- Direct access to leadership and a real say in how we sell to enterprise

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation including equity package

  • Competitive vacation policy

  • Medical Insurance

  • L&D budget

  • Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

  • Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: Our purpose is to create value for the finance teams we serve. We pour our energy into driving impact for them fast, and we measure our success by theirs.

Relentless Ambition: We chose to compete at the top alongside the best. We set ambitious goals, and keep pushing when it gets hard. Nothing worth having comes easy.

One Team: There is no “they” at Abacum: “their” problem is our problem. We’re candid because we care, we help each other grow, and we embrace different perspectives.

title: Implementation Manager - German Speaking (m/w/d)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran. Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt. Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann. 🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns: Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte. Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen. Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden. 🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung: Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich. Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen. Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern. Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen. Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen. Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung. Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt entweder in Berlin, München oder komplett remote in Deutschland; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt. Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen. Du stehst hinter dem Kraken-Ansatz zur Technologieentwicklung, der auf Einfachheit, Kundennutzen und Effizienz beruht, und begleitest die beteiligten Interessengruppen durch den Veränderungsprozess. Du bist bereit, bestehende Überzeugungen zu hinterfragen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven einzunehmen und bei Bedarf auch über deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich hinauszugehen, um den Kunden zu unterstützen. Wir entwickeln Kraken für alle: eine universelle Plattform, bei der gemeinsam genutzte Weiterentwicklungen einen größeren Nutzen schaffen und die grüne Energiewende ermöglichen. Als Pioniere auf diesem Gebiet begeistert uns, wie Kraken das Leben unserer Kunden verändern kann. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Kraken die beste Lösung ist – sowohl für mehr Effizienz als auch als Werkzeug im Kampf gegen die Klimakrise. Wenn du diese Überzeugung teilst, bist du bei Kraken Tech genau richtig. 🧠 Das bringst du mit: In dieser Position steht die Erfüllung der Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden für dich im Mittelpunkt. Wir suchen Menschen mit ausgeprägter Problemlösungskompetenz und einer durchweg positiven, lösungsorientierten Einstellung. Wenn du Herausforderungen gerne annimmst und den Ehrgeiz hast, erfolgreich zu sein, passt diese Position zu dir! Deine Haltung: „Jedes Problem hat eine Lösung. Neue Herausforderungen sind spannend, weil wir durch sie jeden Tag besser werden. Und je größer die Herausforderung, desto größer das Erfolgserlebnis.“ Fundierte Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten und/oder als Product Owner. Erfahrung mit agilen Umsetzungsmethoden. Erfahrung im Produktmanagement und mit Customer Journeys. Ein solides Verständnis von Technologie und den damit verbundenen Trends. Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Team- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten. Überzeugungskraft und die Fähigkeit, traditionelle Denkweisen zu hinterfragen. Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit umfangreichen, komplexen Projekt- und Umsetzungspipelines für Kunden. Geduld und Eigeninitiative: Unsere Kunden durchlaufen tiefgreifende Veränderungen, die Zeit brauchen und unser Verständnis erfordern. Gutes Zeitmanagement und eine tatkräftige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise. Beratungserfahrung ist von Vorteil. Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse. Vorerfahrung in Buchhaltung und Abrechnung oder im Zahlungsverkehr sowie Kenntnisse in FI/CO sind von Vorteil. Da wir ein internationales Unternehmen sind, bitten wir dich, deinen Lebenslauf auf Englisch einzureichen und die Fragen in deiner Bewerbung auf Englisch zu beantworten. Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Die Position ist die eines Client Delivery Lead Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. description: TYTAN Technologies The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in. At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems to join our Platform Team. Our interceptors fly autonomous missions from launch to intercept. Before a software change flies in the air, we want to see it fly on the bench: the real mission computer and flight controller, flying a full simulated mission in real time against simulated physics, sensors and targets. We are taking our hardware-in-the-loop testing to full closed-loop missions, and you lead that build. You are a builder, not a test author. You design the rigs, couple the simulation to the hardware, and build the framework so that our autonomy and perception engineers write and run their own HIL scenarios on every change. Your roadmap to make an impact The closed loop: Couple real-time physics, sensor and target simulation to real flight hardware. Inject IMU, GNSS, camera and other sensor data at the interface the hardware expects, close the loop on actuator commands, and keep latency, jitter and time synchronisation within budget, so a flight on the rig behaves like a flight in the air. Fault injection: Sensor failures, GNSS denial and spoofing, link loss, bus errors and power faults, reproducible on demand. System rigs: Rigs for the current and next generation mission computer and for full system configurations with ground station, radio link and interceptors. Provisioned as code, with automated deployment of builds, remote power control, health monitoring and self-recovery. HIL in CI: Merge-gating regression suites, nightly and long-running mission suites, rig scheduling across pipelines, flaky test detection, and structured results traceable to requirements. Test framework: Fixtures for devices, instruments and simulators, so that a domain engineer writes a HIL test as easily as a unit test, and the same scenario runs in SIL and HIL. HIL as a product: Your users are our autonomy, perception and systems engineers. Availability and time to result are your metrics, also in restricted and air-gapped lab networks. 4+ years building HIL or hardware test systems for embedded or autonomous systems, including at least one closed-loop rig you designed and built yourself, not only operated or wrote test cases for Real-time simulation coupled to hardware: plant and sensor models running in real time against real hardware, on commercial HIL platforms or custom Linux-based rigs Expert Python, plus C or C++ for real-time components Strong Linux and CI: self-hosted runners with hardware in the loop, containerised test environments, device management, remote power and console control Debugging across the hardware and software boundary: embedded interfaces such as CAN, UART, SPI and Ethernet, and timing problems you have measured, not guessed Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience Nice to haves Flight or vehicle dynamics models, and PX4 or ArduPilot SITL/HITL HIL platforms such as dSPACE, NI PXI/VeriStand or Speedgoat Sensor stimulation at the hardware interface: IMU, GNSS, camera and video injection Time synchronisation (e.g. PTP), real-time Linux and jitter measurement Test frameworks at scale (pytest or Robot Framework) and instrument control via SCPI or VISA FMI/FMU or Gazebo-based simulation MAVLink and flight controller interfaces GNSS simulators (e.g. Spirent, Safran Skydel) and RF environment simulation Camera and image generation pipelines for perception testing Requirements-based testing in DO-178C or ISO 26262 contexts Rust for performance-critical test components Firmware for test fixtures on microcontrollers End-of-line test stations Why TYTAN? title: Senior SW Engineer – Embedded Linux SDK & Distribution (M/W/D)
description: Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. Our team is responsible for the core OS DNA of the EyeQ computer vision SoC, defining how the system starts, is composed, and manages its lifecycle in a high-performance automotive environment. We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our Core Distribution team . The center of this role is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and the integration of external SDK into that platform. You will also build Python-based deployment tooling so the OS and SDK stack can be provisioned reproducibly - infrastructure and tool development in service of the OS. What will your job look like: Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent, operational platform under embedded constraints.  Enable and integrate an SDK into the OS image - drivers, libraries, runtimes, and filesystem layout as first-class distribution components. Own distribution composition, including packages, sysroots, and image features that make the SDK and core OS a maintainable, versioned platform. Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment (image delivery, flashing, and environment setup). Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and SDK/runtime issues on the target. Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up through a fully operational stack. Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and related target hardware. All you need is: Outstanding graduate in Computer Science or similar field.   5+ years of experience in Embedded Linux development, with a focus on systems software, userspace, or distribution work. Strong C/C++ skills and a solid understanding of POSIX APIs, libraries, and how userspace talks to the kernel. Deep knowledge of Linux Internals, specifically the boot process (Bootloaders, Kernel hand-off, Init systems) and root filesystem layout. Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux Distributions (e.g., custom Yocto recipes, Buildroot, or Linux-from-scratch). Experience enabling vendor SDKs or BSP stacks on Linux — integrating third-party drivers, runtimes, and userspace components into a custom image. Proficiency in debugging tools like GDB, Valgrind, strace, and perf. Experience with Python for infrastructure and tool development — deployment, packaging, and environment setup. Nice to have: Background in Automotive Software. Experience with GPU/accelerator compute stacks (driver + userspace runtime, inference/compute libraries, cross-sysroot workflows). Familiarity with reading hardware schematics and reasoning about basic hardware interfaces and signal. Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. opportunities.</li> <li>Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance Referenzimplementierungen: Du entwickelst wieder verwendbare KI-Bausteine, Blueprints und Best Practices für unsere Projektteams Eigene Inferenz-Plattform weiterentwickeln: Du entwickelst unseren und SQL Praxis im Betrieb offener KI-Modelle wie vLLM, Ollama, TGI oder SGLang sowie Kenntnisse in GPU-Dimensionierung, Quantisierung und Sprachmodellen wie Whisper Erfahrung mit DevOps und MLOps im title: Sales Specialist/in – Steuerberatung neu gedacht (m/w/d)
description: Du hörst gerne zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und machst aus Interesse eine gute Entscheidung? Dann hilf uns, neue Mandant:innen für b’steuern zu gewinnen. Täglich erreichen uns Menschen, die ihre Steuerberatung verändern wollen. Unser Ziel: So einfach wie möglich für alle Beteiligten – mit der Kraft von Tech und KI. Was uns besonders macht: Radikal digital: Wir setzen auf moderne Software, KI und eigene Tech-Lösungen, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren. Radikal kundenfokussiert: Unsere Mandant:innen bekommen transparente Pakete, klare Preise und verständliche Kommunikation. Radikal selbstorganisiert: Unsere Teams übernehmen Verantwortung und gestalten ihre Zusammenarbeit aktiv mit. Remote-first: Wir arbeiten verteilt und haben ein Office in Berlin-Mitte. Ambitioniertes Wachstum: Wir wollen die Steuerberatung grundlegend weiterentwickeln – und suchen Menschen, die diese Reise mitgestalten. Deine Rolle Du bist die erste persönliche Stimme, die neue Mandant:innen bei b’steuern hören. Unsere Interessent:innen haben sich bereits bewusst bei uns gemeldet. Du greifst ihr Interesse auf und findest gemeinsam mit ihnen heraus, ob unser Angebot zu ihrem Bedarf passt. In einem 30-minütigen Video-Call lernst du sie und ihr Unternehmen kennen, erfasst ihre Ausgangslage und erstellst live ein passendes Angebot. Du erklärst unsere Leistungen, beantwortest Fragen und machst die nächsten Schritte klar. Auch danach bleibst du dran: Du fasst freundlich nach, koordinierst offene Punkte und sorgst bei einer Zusage für eine gute Übergabe an unser Onboarding-Team. Fachliche Fragen klärst du gemeinsam mit unseren Steuerprofis. Deine Aufgaben Kennenlerngespräche führen: Du sprichst in 30-minütigen Video-Calls mit Interessent:innen und verstehst ihre Situation, Erwartungen und Bedürfnisse. Angebote live erstellen: Du stellst passende Leistungen zusammen und erklärst transparent, was enthalten ist und was sie kosten. Entscheidungen begleiten: Du beantwortest Rückfragen, klärst Details und fasst verbindlich nach, wenn noch etwas offen ist. Telefonisch unterstützen: Du bist auch außerhalb der Video-Calls ansprechbar und hilfst Interessent:innen beim nächsten Schritt. CRM zuverlässig pflegen: Du dokumentierst Gespräche, hältst Informationen aktuell und behältst Angebote und Follow-ups im Blick. Übergaben organisieren: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Onboarding-Team und unseren Steuerberater:innen zusammen, damit neue Mandant:innen gut bei uns starten. Abläufe verbessern: Du bringst Erfahrungen aus deinen Gesprächen ein und hilfst uns, Angebote, Kommunikation und Sales-Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln. Was du mitbringst Kommunikationsstärke: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, fragst gezielt nach und erklärst verständlich. Im Video-Call und am Telefon trittst du freundlich und sicher auf. Verständnis für Unternehmertum: Du kannst dich in Selbstständige, Freelancer:innen und Unternehmer:innen hineinversetzen und interessierst dich für ihren Alltag. Neugier auf steuerliche Themen: USt-Voranmeldung, EÜR oder Bilanz musst du zum Einstieg nicht im Detail beherrschen. Du willst aber verstehen, worum es geht und welche Fragen du an unsere Steuerprofis weitergibst. Struktur und Verbindlichkeit: CRM-Pflege, gute Gesprächsnotizen und zuverlässige Follow-ups gehören für dich zu einer professionellen Kundenbeziehung. Eigenverantwortung: Du organisierst deine Arbeit, setzt Prioritäten und bringst offene Themen zum Abschluss. Technologisches Interesse: Du arbeitest gerne mit digitalen Tools und hast Lust, KI sinnvoll in deinen Arbeitsalltag einzubauen. Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Erfahrung in Sales, Kundenberatung oder Customer Success ist willkommen. Entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen verstehst, schnell lernst und zuverlässig dranbleibst. Was wir dir bieten Interessent:innen mit echtem Bedarf: Du sprichst mit Menschen, die sich bereits bei uns gemeldet haben und sich für unsere Leistungen interessieren. Eine zentrale Rolle: Du prägst den ersten persönlichen Eindruck von b’steuern und trägst direkt zu unserem Wachstum bei. Beratung mit klarem Angebot: Transparente Leistungen und Preise geben dir eine gute Grundlage für deine Gespräche. Flexibilität: Du arbeitest remote oder in unserem Office in Berlin-Mitte. Selbstorganisation: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst unsere Zusammenarbeit und Abläufe mitgestalten. Ein vielseitiges Team: Du arbeitest mit Steuerprofis, Tech-Expert:innen und erfahrenen Unternehmer:innen zusammen. Faire Vergütung und Entwicklung: Wir bieten dir ein faires Gehalt und Raum, mit deinen Stärken und unserem Unternehmen zu wachsen. Eine sinnvolle Aufgabe: Du hilfst Menschen, eine passende Steuerberatung zu finden und ihren Steueralltag einfacher zu machen. Warum bei uns einsteigen? Weil gute Sales-Gespräche für uns mit Zuhören anfangen. Du verstehst, was Menschen brauchen, machst unser Angebot greifbar und begleitest sie zu einer fundierten Entscheidung. Gleichzeitig wirst du Teil eines Unternehmens, das Steuerberatung mit KI, Technologie und Selbstorganisation weiterentwickelt. Deine Erfahrungen aus den Gesprächen helfen uns dabei, jeden Tag besser zu werden. Du hast Lust, neue Mandant:innen für diese Art von Steuerberatung zu gewinnen? Dann sollten wir sprechen. title: Initiativbewerbung
description: Du hast Lust, Steuerberatung neu zu denken? Dann bewirb dich initiativ bei b’steuern – einem Berliner Startup, das die Branche radikal verändert. Über uns Wir denken Steuerberatung neu. b’steuern steht für eine agile, digitale und selbstorganisierte Kanzlei. Unser Anspruch: Steuerberatung, die nicht verwaltet – sondern gestaltet. Wir entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für FinTech- und TaxTech-Anbieter sowie deren Kunden – und bieten gleichzeitig direkte Steuerberatungsleistungen für Unternehmen und Selbständige. Dabei verfolgen wir einen klaren Grundsatz: Wir vermeiden unnötige Medienbrüche, manuelle Buchungsübernahmen und ineffiziente Imports aus Vorsystemen. Unser Ziel ist es, mit den Systemen unserer Mandanten zu arbeiten – nicht gegen sie. So reduzieren wir Komplexität und schaffen echte Effizienz – möglichst ohne klassische Kanzleisoftware-Logik. Nach vielen Jahren in der traditionellen Steuerberatung war für uns klar: Es braucht einen strukturellen Neustart. Du hilfst neuen Kolleg:innen, ihre Rolle zu verstehen, Beziehungen im Team aufzubauen und sich in unserer Selbstorganisation zurechtzufinden. Perspektivisch kannst du dich zur Koordinator:in für einzelne Teams entwickeln. In dieser Rolle lernst du Führung aus einem anderen Blickwinkel kennen: Du begleitest Teams dabei, ihre Zusammenarbeit zu reflektieren, Entscheidungen eigenständig zu treffen und gemeinsam wirksamer zu werden. Tech und KI einsetzen: Du nutzt externe Tools und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Tech-Team eigene Lösungen, die unsere People-Prozesse einfacher und besser machen. Mit den Teams zusammenarbeiten: Du machst sichtbar, wo es im Hiring oder Onboarding hakt, holst Feedback ein und verbesserst die Abläufe. Perspektivisch Teams begleiten: Du wächst in die Koordinatorenrolle hinein und unterstützt einzelne Teams bei ihrer Selbstorganisation und Entwicklung. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung im People-Bereich: Du hast praktische Erfahrung in Recruiting, People & Culture oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle – idealerweise in einem wachsenden Unternehmen. Freude an Recruiting und Umsetzung: Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, führst gute Gespräche und hältst Prozesse zuverlässig in Bewegung. Bei 65 neuen Kolleg:innen zählen gute Ideen und konsequente Umsetzung. Gespür für Menschen: Du kannst Fähigkeiten, Erwartungen und Arbeitsweisen einordnen und sprichst offen darüber, ob sie zu einer Rolle und unserem Umfeld passen. Interesse an Selbstorganisation: Du möchtest verstehen, wie Teams Verantwortung gemeinsam tragen und Entscheidungen eigenständig treffen können. Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, setzt Prioritäten und bringst Themen ins Ziel. Technologische Neugier: Du nutzt digitale Tools und KI selbstverständlich und hast Lust, People-Prozesse mit unserem Tech-Team weiterzuentwickeln. Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe: Du hörst zu, gibst klares Feedback und kannst auch schwierige Themen respektvoll ansprechen. Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch. Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Erfahrung im Coaching oder in der Organisationsentwicklung ist willkommen. Du kannst dich bei uns aber auch Schritt für Schritt in diese Richtung entwickeln. Was wir bieten Eine konkrete Aufbauaufgabe: 65 neue Kolleg:innen in 12 Monaten – du gestaltest einen entscheidenden Teil unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase. Ein besonderes Arbeitsumfeld: Du erlebst, wie Steuerberatung, KI und selbststeuernde Teams zusammenwirken. Eine Entwicklungsperspektive: Du kannst in die Koordinatorenrolle hineinwachsen und Teams auf Basis von #AdaptiveOrg begleiten. Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Gründerteam, Joan, unseren Teams und der Tech-Entwicklung zusammen. Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust Prozesse auf, probierst Lösungen aus und entwickelst sie anhand echter Erfahrungen weiter. Remote-first: Du arbeitest flexibel und kannst unser Office in Berlin-Mitte nutzen. Warum bei uns einsteigen? Weil du hier mitgestaltest, wie ein stark wachsendes Unternehmen zusammenarbeitet. Die nächsten 65 Kolleg:innen sollen bei uns Orientierung finden, Verantwortung übernehmen und ihre Stärken einbringen können. Du schaffst dafür gemeinsam mit den Teams die Voraussetzungen. title: Senior Engineering Manager, Ad Performance Recommendation
description: <p>We are seeking a<strong> Senior Engineering Manager</strong> to join our 200+ product development organization and lead our<strong> Ad Performance Recommendation team</strong>. The team is responsible for developing an innovative AI-powered system that leverages marketing ad tech data and various data sources to identify performance signals and generate actionable recommendations for digital advertisers and marketers.&nbsp;</p> <p>As part of the AI Platform organization, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and Software Engineers working to accelerate AI adoption and development across Smartly’s Media, Creative, and Intelligence suite. The team ensures compliance with privacy, security, and ethical guidelines.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to define the vision and strategy for ML and Data Science applications, drive execution on ambitious goals, and champion AI and ML excellence throughout Smartly.</p> <p>Smartly is proud to be ranked as a leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Creative AdTech. This recognition reflects our commitment to transforming ad experiences through intelligent creativity, standing as the only platform honored by both Forrester and validated by PwC to be recognized for ad technology to power performance.</p> <p>To get an idea of some of the work we do, see for example these blog posts:</p> <p><a href="https://www.smartly.io/blog/tutorial-how-we-productized-bayesian-revenue-estimation-with-stan">How We Productized Bayesian Revenue Estimation with Stan</a></p> <p><a href="https://www.smartly.io/blog/optimizing-conversions-with-predictive-budget-allocation">Optimizing Conversions with Predictive Budget Allocation</a></p> <p><strong>Here’s What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and grow the Ad Performance Recommendation team, providing technical direction, strategic vision, and hands-on leadership.</li> <li>Drive the development of AdTech-specific ML models foundational AI capabilities (e.g. predictive and simulation techniques) and explore novel approaches that can be applied across Smartly’s products. Optimize existing models for performance, efficiency, and scalability.</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to ensure AI-driven features deliver measurable business and customer impact.</li> <li>Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and ethical AI standards in ML applications.</li> <li>Foster a strong engineering culture focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Mentor team members through coaching, 1:1s, and career development plans.</li> <li>Remove obstacles to enable your team to thrive and deliver exceptional results.</li> <li>Partner with recruiting to help scale the team by actively sourcing and closing the best talent.&nbsp;</li> <li>Partner with other leaders in the AI Platform to shape Smartly’s long-term AI strategy and architecture.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Here's What We're Looking For…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience in building services and products.</li> <li>5+ years of experience in applying machine learning to real-life problems.</li> <li>3+ years of experience in leading teams.</li> <li>Competent with key technologies in ML; PyTorch, TensorFlow, Python, SQL.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Able to mentor, coach, and develop data scientists and machine learning engineers</li> <li>Proven experience in delivering scalable ML systems in production. You will need to be hands-on when coaching the team members to new technical and professional heights, which can involve code reviews, pair programming, etc.</li> <li>A pragmatic mindset. We always aim to create value to our customers. raw.description:
About the team:

The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp.

We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter.

We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.

 

What you'll do:

  • Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems.
  • Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users.
  • Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers.
  • Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact preferences with confidence.
  • Work with a talented distributed team that values collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Enjoy your work! We are looking for someone to be paid to do what they love.

 

You'll be great for this role if you have:

  • Experience in backend or fullstack development, primarily with Go. Familiarity with other languages like TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, or Swift is a big plus and can be helpful for working across different systems.
  • Excitement for security and reliability topics. Experience with authentication and authorization technologies (e.g. OAuth, Multi-Factor Authentication) would be nice to have.
  • A flexible mindset and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment and navigate complex domains. You are a quick learner and have a proven ability to pick up new skills and concepts swiftly.
  • A structured, proactive way of working. You enjoy working independently but also effectively collaborate with your cross-functional team and other teams.
  • A natural drive to improve things—you're always looking to make systems and processes better. You strive for great solutions, but also know when to be pragmatic.
  • Confidence in asking for help or using available tools (like search engines or AI assistants) when something is beyond your grasp.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written. As part of a globally distributed team, clear and respectful communication is essential.

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖️ Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🍽️ Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform

🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station

🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

 

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

 

About us:

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. 

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.

Explore career opportunities with us and join a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared vision of creating a world where everyone can build a thriving business. Discover more about our vibrant and inclusive work culture and how we work on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn and Instagram.

  • Catch problems before advertisers do. Know what each account should do next before they ask. Push budget increases, geo expansions, format tests on a schedule. Intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

title: Associate Consultant, AI Transformation
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>MAP | WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>MAP is part of<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__http:/wpp.com/__;!!IfJP2Nwhk5Z0yJ43lA!L_cfT4E3gsmmDY1lVQTB6ihlfPeBl9X4sMM2KI6iWZYexC2nCeZ9oxgP9qvgbrqxIBpx82rGb_mWqh5F0zKxq5_dP7Y$" data-outlook-id="5677231c-455b-4705-9250-42d6515234fb">WPP</a>, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.&nbsp;</p></div><p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. We are 12,000 experts across 40+ markets, partnering with the platforms our clients run on: Adobe, AWS, Salesforce and the frontier AI labs.&nbsp;</p> <p>Most of our clients have already invested in agentic AI tooling but have yet to see the promised value gain. We’re helping clients close that gap and realize the value of their AI stack. We are looking for an Associate Consultant to join our AI Transformation work: helping marketing, CRM and content teams find the use cases that matter, build solutions with the tools they own, and move from testing AI to scaling their work with it. You will contribute to the same journey across our global client portfolio and inside MAP, where we treat ourselves as client number one.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <h2>What will your day look like?</h2> <p>In this role, you will build, measure and drive adoption of frontier AI for marketing teams at the world’s biggest brands and for MAP itself. You will sit with teams such as CRM, campaign and content to understand how their work really gets done, then build the skills, MCPs or agents that help them reach their goals. You will be at the frontier of re-designing work to fit the agentic era: you will help showcase where and how AI has an impact on time and quality and where we still need human judgement in the workflows of tomorrow. Your work will make a real difference to people's working lives, giving them time back to focus on more ambitious and creative work. You will be working in tandem with senior profiles from the team who will mentor you and hand you more ownership as you grow.&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Use-case &amp; workflow discovery</strong> – Sit alongside the people who do the work, in client teams and across MAP, such as campaign managers, CRM specialists and content producers, and learn their role in the marketing lifecycle. Help them redesign workflows with state-of-the-art tools and spot where AI could change the cost or speed of a deliverable, while capturing it in use-case templates and a prioritised backlog, and contribute to AI maturity assessments.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Build with teams</strong> – Recommend and build the skills, MCPs, agents and integrations that redesign how a team works, using frontier models, and test them with real users until the new workflow is theirs.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Measure impact</strong> – You will build simple value models for the identified use-cases and shape the success criteria with the team as the work evolves.<u>&nbsp;</u>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Demos for pitches</strong> – Create quick, tailored demos showing how AI can address client challenges, and help present them in pitches and client discussions.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Drive adoption</strong> – Help client and MAP teams upskill with AI: run knowledge-sharing sessions and office hours, write the playbooks teams use after you leave, support champion networks, and keep an adoption scorecard that shows leadership what is working.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>Who are you going to work with?</h2> <p>You will join the AI Solutions Consulting team at MAP, and work alongside our team of AI engineers. Day to day you will work with senior AI consultants and with colleagues across WPP Enterprise Solutions, from experience strategy to client engagement. Your clients will include some of the world's biggest brands in industries such as FMCG, automotive, energy, food service and retail.&nbsp;</p> <h2>What do you bring to the table?</h2> <p>We hire for a mindset, not a background. Demoing work you have built matters more than where you built it.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you must have&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A relevant degree or early experience.</strong> You have completed a degree in a relevant field such as digital innovation, strategy and technology, management, business analytics, philosophy, design or computer science, or up to 2 years' experience in consulting, marketing operations, CRM or a related role.<br><br></li> <li><strong>You are AI-native.</strong> You work with the agent in the middle, and you regularly build things with LLM’s: a workflow you automated, a skill others use, a tool you wired together. We will ask you to walk us through something you built, how and why, not just the output.<br><br></li> <li><strong>You are fascinated by brands and the art of persuasion.</strong> You want to understand how AI can transform and broaden the traditional marketing lifecycle, and you use what you know to improve how teams work, earning their trust as someone who makes their job better.<br><br></li> <li><strong>You think like an experimenter.</strong> You test and learn: set a baseline, measure what changed and decide what to do next, with the curiosity and discipline to grow and scale what works.<br><br></li> <li><strong>A proactive and organized way of working.</strong> You take a brief and come back with something real, you unblock yourself, and you keep several client threads moving at once without dropping one.<br><br></li> <li><strong>You explain AI clearly.</strong> You can make AI make sense to people who don't work with it every day, in writing and in the room.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>What sets you apart&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience in a marketing, CRM, customer experience or martech team, including familiarity with Adobe, Salesforce or Braze.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You have designed or run at least one workshop or training session for non-technical teams.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You have been part of at least one change-management, adoption or AI transformation programme, in any setting.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Experience building with AI engineering tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor – we do not expect you to be a software engineer.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>You are welcome to use AI to help with your application. Just tell us how you used it.&nbsp;</p> <h2>A leader in personalized customer experiences</h2> <p></p> <p>MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer-centric. Together, we are 1000 + technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55+ nationalities.</p> <p>#LI-NAMER</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB">WPP (MAP/VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></span><span class="scxw176048299"><span lang="EN-GB">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p>When you click “Apply now” below, your information is sent to MAP/VML. To learn more about how we process your personal data during when you apply for a role with us, on how you can update your information or have the information removed please read our&nbsp;<u><a href="https://wt-map.com/privacy-policy" data-outlook-id="1be1ea03-7c74-4825-b023-8bda1dc2d911">Privacy policy</a></u>. California residents should read our&nbsp;<u><a href="https://www.wundermanthompson.com/california-recruitment-privacy-notice" data-outlook-id="02863cf9-cae6-4a11-b7f1-4f68ba8e0816">California Recruitment Privacy Notice</a></u>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager - Reconciliation
description: <p><strong>About us:</strong></p> <p>BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.</p> <p>We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.</p> <p><strong>Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.</strong></p> <p>Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.</p> <p>By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.</p> <p>We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.</p> <p>We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:</p> <ul> <li>CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)</li> <li>FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)</li> <li>Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)</li> <li>LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About this role in the team:</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Reconciliation and Financial Reporting at BVNK.</p> <p>Your mission is to make sure every movement of money across the BVNK platform, in fiat and in stablecoins, is accounted for, matched and reported correctly. You'll own our internal financial reporting engine and reconciliation platform, and make sure every product we build, including the products we're building with Mastercard, goes live with the right reconciliation and reporting in place.</p> <p>This is an operations and data-heavy product. You'll work closely with the Reconciliation Operations and Operations Delivery teams to understand where breaks and manual work come from, and turn that into a prioritised backlog. You'll also partner with finance, treasury and compliance, who rely on accurate reconciliation for safeguarding, month-end close and regulatory reporting.</p> <p>You'll work with engineers across the payments, wallets and ledger teams on the data structures and events that reconciliation depends on, and with small, autonomous engineering squads across BVNK. We see AI as a key lever in how we build, and we expect you to use it in your day-to-day work.</p> <p><strong>Key Areas of Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the reconciliation and reporting strategy and roadmap, from how transaction data is captured at source to the reports that finance, operations and regulators rely on.</li> <li>Own BVNK's internal financial reporting engine, including balance, transaction, fee and safeguarding reporting, and make sure it is accurate, timely and auditable.</li> <li>Make sure every new product, currency, payment rail, banking partner and blockchain network is backed by the correct reconciliation and reporting before it launches. Build reconciliation requirements into launch readiness, and work with other PMs so they are planned from the start rather than added afterwards.</li> <li>Work closely with the Reconciliation Operations and Operations Delivery teams to find the root causes of breaks, exceptions and manual workarounds, and build the backlog accordingly.</li> <li>Work with engineers on the payments, wallets and events data structures, so that every transaction carries the identifiers, statuses and metadata needed to match it automatically across internal ledgers, bank and PSP statements, and on-chain activity.</li> <li>Improve the matching engine and exception tooling, including matching rules, break ageing and investigation workflows, and audit trails.</li> <li>Own how external data comes into the platform, such as bank statements (for example camt.053 and MT940), PSP and liquidity provider reports, and blockchain data, along with the data quality controls around it.</li> <li>Partner with finance, treasury, compliance and audit on safeguarding reconciliation, month-end close, and regulatory and audit reporting.</li> <li>Take part in resolving reconciliation and regulatory incidents, including safeguarding incidents. When issues arise, respond quickly, work with Operations, Engineering, Finance and Compliance to find the cause and fix it, and follow up with product changes that stop it happening again.</li> <li>Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and see work through to release.</li> <li>Define and track the measures that matter, such as auto-match rate, number and age of open breaks, time to resolve, reporting timeliness and manual effort. Use data to decide what to build next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we need from you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Several years of product management experience in payments, banking or fintech, ideally owning reconciliation, ledger, finance or reporting products.</li> <li>Solid technical knowledge. You're comfortable working with engineers on data models, ledgers, event-driven systems, APIs and data pipelines, and you can reason about technical trade-offs without needing to write the code. You're happy to query data yourself using SQL.</li> <li>A good understanding of reconciliation and financial reporting: double-entry accounting, transaction lifecycles, settlement, matching logic and why breaks happen.</li> <li>Experience in operations, or working closely with operations teams. You understand how exceptions and manual processes are handled day to day, and you build products that reduce them. When something goes wrong, you respond quickly and stay calm under pressure.</li> <li>Experience in the payments and/or banking industry, for example with payment schemes such as SEPA, ACH, Faster Payments or SWIFT, bank statement formats, or settlement with banks and PSPs.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills. You write clearly, present confidently to senior leaders and explain complex topics simply to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>The ability to build and articulate plans, and to align and communicate on them with other PMs and stakeholders. You manage dependencies across teams, handle competing priorities and can say no with a clear rationale.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity. You create structure where requirements are still evolving and keep complex work moving.</li> <li>An AI-native mindset. You're an early adopter of AI tools and agentic workflows, and you use them to research, analyse, write specifications and design solutions, not just to summarise.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with stablecoins, blockchain networks or crypto operations, including on-chain reconciliation of wallets.</li> <li>Experience building or replacing a reconciliation platform, either in-house or with a vendor.</li> <li>Experience with safeguarding or regulatory reporting for e-money or payment institutions.</li> <li>Experience with products that run across several regulated entities or jurisdictions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you can expect from us:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fair and <strong>competitive salary</strong> at every stage of your growth</li> <li><strong>Flexible working</strong> hours, with hybrid working at its heart</li> <li>A <strong>culture</strong> built on passionate, growth-minded people</li> <li>A <strong>flexible approach to holiday</strong></li> <li>Opportunities to travel to our <strong>offices around the world</strong></li> <li>An <strong>open and creative environment</strong> where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets</li> </ul> <p><em>At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team. </em></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.</p></div><div class="title">Bulgaria Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€75.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€100.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.</p></div><div class="title">Spain Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€75.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€120.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.</p></div><div class="title">Malta Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€75.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€110.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.</p></div><div class="title">Poland Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>330 000 zł</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>420 000 zł PLN</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Getting a payment out of the door is only half the job. What happens next (a return, a recall, a rejected payment, a compliance hold, an investigation or a customer query) is where trust is won or lost. Your mission is to make those processes fast, reliable, automated and compliant, at scale.</p> <p>You'll own the product strategy for the post-initiation and exception lifecycle of fiat payments: returns, recalls, rejections, repairs, investigations, compliance-driven holds and releases, and the tooling our operations teams use to manage them. You'll work hand in hand with payment operations, compliance, financial crime, treasury, finance and our banking partners to turn manual processes into well-designed product capabilities.</p> <p>You'll partner with senior product managers, engineers and architects and with small, autonomous engineering squads, and you'll take products from discovery and design all the way through to launch. We see AI as a key lever in how we build and operate, and we expect you to use it in your day-to-day work.</p> <p><strong>Key Areas of Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the product strategy and roadmap for FIAT payment operations, covering the full exception lifecycle of payment flows across all schemes we support: SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst), SWIFT, ACH, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP and Faster Payments.</li> <li>Design and deliver scheme-compliant handling of returns, recalls, rejections, cancellations, payment repairs and investigations, including the related ISO 20022 messages (e.g. pacs.004, camt.056, camt.029) and their equivalents on non-ISO rails.</li> <li>Build compliance processes into payment flows from the start: sanctions and transaction screening outcomes, holds and releases, Requests for Information (RFIs), Verification of Payee / Confirmation of Payee, Travel Rule and fraud-related recalls, working closely with Operation, compliance and financial crime teams.</li> <li>Drive straight-through processing and automation. Keep BVNK ahead of regulatory and scheme updates.</li> <li>Define and track the measures that matter, such as exception rates, time to resolve returns and recalls, recall success rates, STP rates, operational cost per transaction, SLA adherence and customer satisfaction. Use data to decide what to build next.</li> <li>Make sure capabilities are built once, on one shared BVNK platform, so every scheme, entity and partner benefits.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we need from you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Several years of product management experience, including owning complex B2B products in payments or fintech end-to-end, from discovery and design through to launch and commercialisation.</li> <li>Solid knowledge of a product framework you've applied in practice: discovery, prioritisation, delivery, launch, go-to-market and post-launch iteration.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with fiat payment schemes such as SEPA, SEPA Instant, SWIFT, ACH, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP and Faster Payments, and a deep understanding of how payments behave after initiation.</li> <li>Experience with payment operations processes: returns, recalls, rejections, investigations, exceptions and reconciliation. You know the scheme rules, reason codes and timelines, and you know where things break in practice.</li> <li>A track record of building compliance- and operations-heavy products in regulated environments, working closely with compliance, financial crime and operations teams on topics such as sanctions screening, payment holds, RFIs and fraud.</li> <li>Strong technical skills. You bring structure to complex, cross-functional problems and keep things moving.</li> <li>An AI-native mindset. You're an early adopter of AI tools and agentic workflows, and you use them to research, analyse, write specifications and design solutions, including spotting where AI can automate operational work.</li> <li>Bonus: experience building internal operations tooling, case management or workflow products.</li> <li>Bonus: experience working directly with sponsor banks, payment service providers or scheme operators.</li> <li>Bonus: experience with products that run across several regulated entities or jurisdictions (e.g. UK, EU, US).</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you can expect from us:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fair and<strong> competitive salary </strong>at every stage of your growth</li> <li><strong>Flexible</strong> working hours, with hybrid working at its heart</li> <li>A <strong>culture</strong> built on passionate, growth-minded people</li> <li>A <strong>flexible</strong> approach to holiday</li> <li>Opportunities to travel to our <strong>offices around the world</strong></li> <li>An <strong>open and creative environment</strong> where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets.</li> </ul> <p><em>At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. description: <div> <p><strong>About us:</strong></p> <p>BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.</p> <p>We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.</p> <p><strong>Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.</strong></p> <p>Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.</p> <p>By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.</p> <p>We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.</p> <p>We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:</p> <ul> <li>CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)</li> <li>FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)</li> <li>Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)</li> <li>LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About this role in the team:</strong></p> <p><strong>We are currently looking for a Senior Crypto Analyst to join our fast growing FCI team</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Financial Crime Intelligence Analyst, you'll play a key role in handling screening and transaction monitoring alerts to prevent bad actors from processing transactions through BVNK. You’ll also conduct in-depth analysis and thorough investigations to address complex and varied financial crime threats. You’ll be taking ownership of cases triggered by BVNK’s financial crime systems and controls, focussing primarily on BVNK’s digital assets offering, and mitigating financial crime risks for BVNK. While this role focuses on BVNK’s digital assets offering, your cases will inevitably crossover with the world of fiat currency and you’ll have the opportunity to support cutting-edge investigations in fiat and digital assets.<br><br>We are seeking a candidate who can commit to a full-time schedule working from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. (CEST).</p> <p>We are looking for a team player; someone who is adaptable and enjoys solving complex problems in a constantly changing environment. You must be adept at managing competing priorities, and work well in a highly demanding environment. You will be comfortable delivering high quality investigations at pace, and presenting your findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.</p> <p><strong>As a Senior Financial Crime Intelligence Analyst, your day-to-day role will be varied, but will include tasks such as:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Reviewing of sanctions and watchlist screening alerts on entities and individuals on relevant lists;</li> <li>Management of end-to-end financial crime investigations stemming from BVNK’s transaction monitoring system, Trade Surveillance, payment screening tools, blockchain analytics provider, and other triggers;</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve workflows and business processes through the effective use of AI tools and automation;</li> <li>Receiving escalations from, and providing coaching to, more junior team members;</li> <li>Drafting of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) for submission to the relevant authorities;</li> <li>Working closely with colleagues responsible for BVNK’s transaction monitoring systems; identifying and testing changes to the rules in our transaction monitoring system;</li> <li>Seeking out and escalating opportunities to enhance BVNK’s control environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’d love to hear from you if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have at least 3 years’ experience in crypto transaction monitoring within a regulated institution or digital assets setting. Experience in a B2B context is essential, as we are primarily a B2B business. Familiarity with B2C environments is a plus, and experience across both crypto and fiat transaction monitoring environments would be advantageous;</li> <li>You have experience reviewing sanctions and watchlist screening alerts, within a regulated institution or digital asset setting;</li> <li>You have experience using tools such as Chainalysis, Elliptic, or TRM (or equivalent). Any blockchain related investigative certifications are desirable but not required;</li> <li>Experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to streamline processes, automate routine tasks, and drive operational improvements;</li> <li>Strong knowledge of AML/CTF regulations, financial crime typologies, and risk-based compliance frameworks is required;</li> <li>Knowledge of Trade Surveillance would be an asset;</li> <li>You’ve drafted and submitted Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs);</li> <li>You’re a motivated and proactive individual contributor, who takes pride in the quality of your work;</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving and demanding environment, often with competing priorities;</li> <li>You’re happy working with a high degree of autonomy and managing evolving priorities to deliver against the team's strategy;</li> <li>You have an interest in digital assets, and are looking for an opportunity to expand your knowledge in this space;&nbsp;</li> <li>You have exceptional written and verbal English;</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you can expect from us:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fair and&nbsp;<strong>competitive salary</strong>&nbsp;at every stage of your growth</li> <li><strong>Flexible working</strong>&nbsp;hours, with hybrid working at its heart</li> <li>A&nbsp;<strong>culture</strong>&nbsp;built on passionate growth-minded people</li> <li>A&nbsp;<strong>flexible approach to holiday</strong></li> <li>Opportunities to travel to our&nbsp;<strong>offices around the world</strong></li> <li>An&nbsp;<strong>open and creative environment</strong>&nbsp;where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets</li> </ul> <p><em>At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.</em></p> </div> <div class="job__pay-ranges"> <div class="pay-range"> <div class="description"> <div class="body">&nbsp;</div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
