raw.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

This is a full-ownership product role at the centre of one of Allica's most effective growth channels. Accountants already introduce established SMEs to Allica and are often the first port of call when those clients make financial decisions. You will be responsible for turning that relationship into a product experience that drives more recommendations, retention and product depth across their client base. You will define and deliver Allica's proposition for accountants: a product that must feel trustworthy, work flawlessly across a portfolio of client accounts, and set the standard for how Allica builds propositions for the specific people and partners around our SME customers.

You will own the full product lifecycle: setting strategy, shaping the roadmap, leading your squad, and being accountable for commercial outcomes. You will work with a deep understanding of how accountants operate, such as day-to-day reconciliation, VAT and payroll processing, and cash flow advisory across a portfolio of clients, and bring that expertise to bear on a product that is both ambitious and grounded in what accountants and their SME clients actually need.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy, vision, roadmap and execution for Allica's accountants proposition

  • Lead a cross-functional squad (Engineering, Design, Data and Operations) to deliver high-quality customer-facing product features

  • Take full commercial accountability for your squad's OKRs — including accountant-driven customer acquisition, growth, retention, and product depth across accountant-connected SMEs

  • Define and implement the accountant access model, from read-only visibility into client accounts toward richer permissions and access controls

  • Define and deliver the accountant-facing product experience — a multi-client experience and workflow tools that help accountants monitor, reconcile and advise across their portfolio of SME clients

  • Partner with Design, UX and Research to use customer discovery, prototyping and iterative research with both accountants and their SME clients to validate what to build next

  • Define metrics, track outcomes, and anchor all decisions in data — building a culture of evidence-based product development within the squad

  • Identify and manage product, regulatory, and delivery risks proactively, working closely with Compliance and Risk teams to ensure the product meets all relevant obligations

  • Maintain a clear and well-communicated roadmap, providing regular updates to the Tribe Lead, wider squads and leadership

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Significant experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager in financial services, ideally building products for accountants, bookkeepers or other professional services audiences

  • Deep understanding of how accountants and bookkeepers operate day to day, including practice workflows, client management, and common accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks and Sage

  • Experience taking a product from early MVP to a fully-fledged proposition, ideally within banking, fintech or professional services software

  • Strong commercial acumen — comfortable owning OKRs and making data-driven prioritisation decisions

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently across technical, commercial and regulatory audiences

  • Decisive, with a track record of moving quickly while maintaining quality and managing risk appropriately

  • Experience working in agile squads with Engineers, Designers, Data Analysts and Operations

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

raw.description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The team

You'll join our Operational Controls team within the Service guild, working across all operations functions. This team is the backbone of how Griffin stays compliant and keeps operational risk visible and manageable as we scale.

The opportunity

We're looking for someone to become the person who tells us, with confidence, whether our operations are actually working the way we think they are. You'll build and run our first-line controls programme from the ground up, working across deeply technical specialists and senior stakeholders alike. As Griffin scales, our control framework has to scale with it. You'll be central to making that happen, turning quality controls and assurance into a genuine source of confidence for the business.

What success looks like

In your first year, you'll have built meaningful relationships across every corner of Griffin, from operations teams to second line risk and compliance. You'll have helped stand up our controls capabilities from scratch, and you'll have taken full ownership of the RCSA process for the Service guild. Along the way, you'll have developed the QA/QC testing frameworks and MI that help leadership see exactly where our controls are strong and where they need attention.

To do this you'll own

  • Quality assurance reviews and quality control testing across operations, ensuring processes are executed accurately and in line with approved procedures

  • Sample-based testing and control checks, identifying errors, control gaps, exceptions, and potential operational risks

  • Corrective action and remediation plans, working with operations teams to close out issues within agreed timelines

  • The Service guild controls attestation framework, and support risk owners in first-line RCSA exercises

  • QA/QC testing frameworks, control checklists, sampling methodologies, and quality standards

  • Regular QA/QC reporting and MI, feeding into Griffin-wide operational risk reporting

  • Coordination of internal audit, external audit, compliance, risk, and regulatory reviews, providing evidence of operational controls and remediation

We expect you to shape this role:

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves,that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

We're looking for people who have:

  • Strong experience in Operations QA/QC, control testing, transaction testing, or operational risk management within a bank or financial institution

  • Experience reviewing operational processes and identifying errors, exceptions, control weaknesses, and process gaps

  • Experience making recommendations to strengthen controls.

  • Strong analytical and MI/data analysis skills, with experience producing QA/QC reports, dashboards, and trend analysis

  • The ability to challenge Operations constructively and operate with an independent control mindset

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)

What can we offer you?

  • Salary: £50-60k (DOE)

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 28 days’ holiday + bank holidays

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks.

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here.

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We don’t work with recruitment agencies, so please don’t send us speculative CVs.

Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. Summary We're looking for a forward-thinking Security Engineer to join our security team, focused on offensive and defensive testing, penetration testing of product features, and the cloud architecture behind the product. You'll operate across a complex multi-cloud environment (AWS & GCP) spanning traditional VMs and modern managed and unmanaged container-based architectures, partnering with fellow Penetration Testing and Cloud Security engineers to run targeted assessments during the testing window immediately before each release. The role reaches beyond the application layer into the Control Plane, reviewing cloud configurations, IAM policies, and orchestration layers against security baselines, and extends to the frontline of external defense by triaging bug bounty submissions and outside vulnerability reports. AI and large language models are core to how this team works day to day — you'll use them to accelerate reconnaissance, generate attack vectors, analyze configurations, and draft vulnerability reports, while applying human judgment to validate findings and communicate risk clearly to product teams. Speed matters here: the team's operating cadence is built around identifying, validating, and reporting vulnerabilities quickly enough to keep pace with release velocity. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: Ensure new product features and the underlying multi-cloud (AWS/GCP) infrastructure are rigorously security-tested before release, and that vulnerabilities surfaced internally or via bug bounty are triaged and communicated with speed and precision. Success Metrics / KPIs : Percentage of roadmap features assessed within the pre-release testing window. Mean time to triage and validate bug bounty / external vulnerability reports. Reduction in critical/high-severity vulnerabilities escaping to production post-release. Time saved per assessment cycle through AI-assisted tooling and automation. Quality and actionability of vulnerability reports and PoCs, as rated by product teams. What You'll Do Conduct deep-dive penetration tests of products across a multi-cloud (AWS & GCP) environment, working in tandem with a peer pentester. Review IAM policies, service configurations, and cloud-native permission structures across the Control Plane to ensure cloud configurations meet security baselines. Execute dynamic testing against web interfaces and API endpoints (Data Plane & Web UI). Assess the security posture of hybrid infrastructure spanning containers and virtual machines. Triage findings, build clear and reproducible proofs-of-concept, and partner with product teams to explain risk and drive remediation. Use AI and large language models to automate reconnaissance, generate attack vectors, analyze configurations, and draft vulnerability reports, applying strong prompt-engineering skills to security contexts. Monitor bug bounty pipelines and external reports, validating findings and managing researcher communication. Functional Competencies Required: Multi-Cloud Fluency: Deep architectural understanding of GCP and AWS. Capable of pivoting seamlessly between providers, performing manual configuration reviews of complex IAM/Resource hierarchies, and leveraging native APIs or modern CSPM frameworks to validate security controls. Container Security: Proven experience auditing and hardening managed container services (GKE Autopilot/Standard, EKS, ECS) and self-hosted/unmanaged workloads (K8s, k3s, OCI-runc). AI Tooling: Demonstrated ability to integrate AI/LLM tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) into the pentesting lifecycle to increase speed and coverage. Web Application Security: Expert-level knowledge of web application security principles and offensive testing methodologies, with deep proficiency in OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, modern web framework exploitation, and API security (REST, WebSockets). Extensive hands-on experience conducting manual security assessments using Burp Suite Professional, OWASP ZAP, or similar tooling. Strong understanding of browser security mechanisms (CSP, CORS, SameSite cookies, Subresource Integrity), secure authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT), and security header configurations (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy). Proven ability to identify complex security flaws beyond automated scanner detection, validate findings through proof-of-concept development, and provide actionable remediation guidance to engineering teams. Security Automation: Proficiency in Python, Go, or Bash to eliminate "toil" — writing custom scripts and tooling to automate vulnerability discovery, validate security controls, and streamline testing workflows. Infrastructure as Code: Solid grasp of Terraform and cloud-native deployment patterns; able to interpret and audit complex HCL files to identify misconfigurations before they are provisioned. Communication: Ability to write high-quality technical reports that Product Teams can easily understand and act upon. Preferred / Nice to Have: Experience with Gatekeeper policies and Binary Authorization. Our Compensation and Benefits At Menlo Security, Base Salary is one part of our competitive total compensation and benefits package and is determined using a salary range. The base salary range for this role is 158,000 CAD - 237,000 CAD. In accordance with Canadian law, the range provided is Menlo Security’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may be higher or lower, based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. All employees may be eligible to become Menlo Security shareholders through eligibility for stock-based compensation grants, which are awarded to employees based on company and individual performance. Menlo Security does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm recruiters. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. Menlo Security is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. Follow us on LinkedIn ! Why Menlo? At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership , Straight Talk , United Impact , Elevated Talent , and Customer-Compelled . We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability . Inherently curious, proactive, and enjoys digging beyond the surface to uncover insights. Exceptional at finding trends and the story in the data, articulating the “so what,” and translating insights into strategic, actionable recommendations. Passionate about customer-centricity and data-driven strategy, with the ability to effectively communicate and influence key stakeholders. Working in one of our <strong>Central European offices </strong>or <strong>from home on a full-time basis</strong>, you’ll become a core part of the Engagement product team.</p> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Define and execute the <strong>product vision and roadmap</strong> for Web Personalization.</li> <li>Partner closely with design, engineering, and GTM teams to build capabilities that:</li> <ul> <li>Make <strong>web personalization simple and powerful for marketers</strong>.</li> <li>Integrate deeply with our <strong>core data &amp; decisioning</strong> capabilities.</li> <li>Differentiate Bloomreach vs. competitors in <strong>web &amp; app personalization</strong>.</li> <li>Lead the transformation of this area into the <strong>era of AI, Agents and LLMs</strong>.</li> </ul> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Team / Product Area</strong></h2> <p>Bloomreach Engagement is our <strong>marketing automation</strong> product, used by digital-first brands to orchestrate cross-channel journeys across <strong>email, SMS, mobile, web, and ads</strong>.</p> <p>The <strong>Web Personalization</strong> product area includes (non-exhaustive):</p> <ul> <li><strong>Weblayers / onsite experiences</strong> (banners, pop-ups, forms, etc.).</li> <li><strong>Web experiments</strong> (A/B tests, variations, targeting).</li> <li><strong>Scenario orchestration</strong> for website experiences (e.g., <em>weblayers in scenarios</em>).</li> <li>Supporting components: web SDKs, targeting, frequency capping, templates, analytics.</li> </ul> <p>Your mandate is to make this stack:</p> <ul> <li><strong>More powerful</strong> (better decisioning, targeting, personalization).</li> <li><strong>Easier to use</strong> (for marketers, not just technical users).</li> <li><strong>Better connected</strong> (to Engagement data, AI, and other channels).</li> <li><strong>AI native</strong> (transforming existing approaches to new experiences).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Tasks and Responsibilities</strong></h2> <p>As Product Manager for Web Personalization, you will:</p> <h3><strong>Product Strategy &amp; Roadmap</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define and evolve the <strong>product strategy</strong> for Web Personalization aligned with Engagement’s overall vision.</li> <li>Maintain a <strong>clear roadmap</strong> for your area, balancing:</li> <ul> <li>Customer-impacting improvements.</li> <li>Strategic differentiators (e.g. AI-driven personalization, agentic orchestration).</li> <li>Technical investments (performance, scalability, UX simplification).</li> </ul> <li>Translate strategy into <strong>clear problem statements, outcomes, and success metrics</strong>.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Discovery &amp; Capabilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Customer-centric problem solver</strong>: You can turn messy feedback into crisp problem statements. title: CDI - Senior Platform Engineer - Paris
description: <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Activités et responsabilités</strong></p> <p>Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production.</p> <p>Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context &amp; Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.</p> </li> <li> <p>Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li> <p>Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.</p> </li> <li> <p>Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</p> </li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage.</p> </li> <li> <p>FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts.</p> </li> <li> <p>Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une certification cloud.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.</p> </li> <li> <p>Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li> <p>Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.</p> </li> <li> <p>Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</p> </li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage.</p> </li> <li> <p>FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts.</p> </li> <li> <p>Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une certification cloud.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. 🗒️ Missions

1. Stratégie SEO

  • Réaliser des audits SEO complets : technique, sémantique, contenu, popularité, UX et performance

  • Définir une stratégie SEO alignée avec les objectifs business, marketing et acquisition

  • Identifier les opportunités de croissance organique sur les moteurs de recherche

  • Construire des roadmaps SEO priorisées selon l’impact, la faisabilité et les ressources disponibles

  • Piloter les optimisations on-site et off-site

2. Optimisation technique

  • Analyser la structure du site, l’indexation, le crawl, le maillage interne et les performances techniques

  • Formuler des recommandations sur :

    • architecture de l’information

    • balisage HTML

    • données structurées

    • Core Web Vitals

    • gestion des redirections

    • canonicals

    • pagination

    • fichiers robots.txt et sitemaps

  • Collaborer avec les équipes techniques pour la bonne implémentation des recommandations

3. Stratégie de contenu et sémantique

  • Réaliser des études de mots-clés et cartographies d’intention

  • Identifier les clusters thématiques et opportunités éditoriales

  • Définir des briefs SEO à destination des rédacteurs ou des équipes contenu

  • Optimiser les contenus existants et recommander de nouvelles productions

  • Mettre en place une logique de maillage interne cohérente

4. GEO / Visibilité dans les moteurs génératifs

  • Définir une stratégie de visibilité adaptée aux moteurs de réponse et interfaces IA

  • Identifier les leviers permettant à la marque, ses contenus ou ses expertises d’être mieux cités, repris ou synthétisés dans les environnements génératifs

  • Recommander des optimisations liées à :

    • clarté et structuration de l’information

    • autorité éditoriale

    • signaux de confiance

    • entités et cohérence sémantique

  • Assurer une veille active sur les évolutions des moteurs génératifs, LLM et nouveaux usages de recherche

  • Définir les KPI de suivi SEO / GEO

  • Mettre en place des tableaux de bord de performance

  • Suivre l’évolution de la visibilité, du trafic organique, des positions, des conversions et des signaux de notoriété

  • Produire des reportings clairs, actionnables et orientés résultats

  • Présenter les analyses et recommandations aux interlocuteurs métiers et décisionnaires

  • Conseiller les équipes marketing, contenu, produit et technique

  • Sensibiliser les parties prenantes aux bonnes pratiques SEO / GEO

  • Participer aux arbitrages stratégiques

  • Former ponctuellement les équipes internes si nécessaire

raw.description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? 

Vision: 

As a global software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust offers an integrated suite of legal and governance solutions. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world’s leading Legal Tech company. 

Our Impact: 

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams across 12 offices in France, the United States, Mexico, Dubai, Morocco, Germany, Spain, Italy and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America and the Middle East. 

Our Recognition: 

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the “Happy at Work” and “Tech at Work” labels every year since 2019. 

The role 

DiliTrust’s R&D organization is undergoing a deep transformation toward AI-driven engineering across every role, from Product and QA to DevOps, Engineering and Architecture. In this context, business knowledge becomes a strategic asset: it must be explicit, structured and shared so that both our teams and our AI agents can consistently build the right product. 

Reporting to the Head of Architecture, you will be responsible for the functional coherence of the entire DiliTrust platform, covering all business modules and internal services. You will map our business domains, define functional design standards and ensure they are applied—including by building the AI agents that automate functional validation. 

This is a role with real authority and a progressive mandate. You will start as a trusted advisor to Product and Engineering teams, then progressively become the approval authority for functional design across the platform. Your ability to simplify complex systems and connect business knowledge with technical execution will be central to your impact. 

Missions: 

  • Map the platform’s business domains: Build and maintain a comprehensive model of capabilities, processes, business rules and data entities across all business modules and internal services, starting with priority areas and expanding progressively. 

  • Simplify and rationalize the functional landscape: Apply Domain-Driven Design to define bounded contexts, establish a ubiquitous language and map relationships between contexts. Identify overlaps, gaps and inconsistencies, and clarify shared concepts such as users, entities, documents, workflows, permissions and audit trails. 

  • Establish functional design governance: Define principles, standards and reusable patterns; review and approve functional designs and specifications against the global model. Build a clear decision-making framework through documented rules, decision records and review rituals. 

  • Make business knowledge usable by people and AI: Maintain a living, machine-readable source of truth comprising domain models, a business glossary and precise specifications. Support spec-driven development and embed this knowledge into the context, skills and tooling used by AI agents across R&D. 

  • Build AI-driven functional validation: Design, build and maintain your own AI agents to check specifications, user stories and designs against the domain model and design rules. Assess and improve the functional quality and reliability of AI outputs across coding, testing and review. 

  • Align functional and technical architecture: Work with technical architects on APIs, events and data models, ensuring that DDD bounded contexts translate into well-isolated domains within a hexagonal architecture, with business logic independent of infrastructure. 

  • Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, Engineering Managers, QA and technical architects to resolve functional inconsistencies and ensure that product and engineering decisions remain coherent across the platform. 

  • Coach teams and champion functional practices: Act as a reference on functional topics, onboarding and coaching teams on the domain model, design standards and ways of working. 

Requirements 

  • Based in France with full working rights. 

  • Fluent in French and English. 

Experience & seniority: 

  • 10+ years of experience in software, including significant experience in system modeling and functional or solution design on complex B2B SaaS platforms. 

  • Proven experience mapping and rationalizing a complex, multi-product platform with a long history. 

  • Demonstrated ability to connect business needs, functional models and engineering decisions. 

  • Legal Tech experience is not required. 

Technical expertise: 

  • Strong command of strategic and tactical Domain-Driven Design: bounded contexts, ubiquitous language, context mapping, aggregates, entities, value objects and domain events. 

  • Proficiency in process and system modeling using approaches such as BPMN, UML, C4 and event storming. 

  • Ability to write precise specifications, business rules and acceptance criteria, including formats such as Gherkin. 

  • Solid understanding of hexagonal architecture, APIs, data models and event-driven architectures, enabling you to engage as a peer with technical architects. 

  • Daily use of LLM assistants and AI agents, with the ability to quickly master new tools. 

  • Hands-on ability to build and iterate on AI agents through prompting, context engineering, skills, MCP, scripting or low-code approaches as needed. 

  • Good understanding of how to evaluate and improve the functional accuracy and reliability of AI outputs. 

Leadership & collaboration: 

  • Strong systems thinking: you understand the whole, recognize interactions and design for coherence over time. 

  • A proven ability to simplify rather than add complexity, favoring clear concepts, clean boundaries and minimal models. 

  • Structured, concise thinking and the ability to make complex topics understandable to others. 

  • The ability to build trust and influence first, then hold a firm line on standards when needed. 

  • Excellent communication, teaching and coaching skills across business and technical teams. 

Education: 

Your background may be functional—business analysis, product or functional architecture—or technical, such as software engineering or architecture. What matters is your ability to model complex systems and bridge business and technology. 

Our Tech Stack 

For information only: the stack evolves continuously, and hands-on expertise in every technology is not expected for this role. 

Area 

Technologies 

Backend 

Node.js / TypeScript, PHP / Symfony, Go, Python 

Frontend 

Vue.js 3 

Database 

PostgreSQL, MariaDB 

DevOps & CI/CD 

Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub, GitHub Actions 

Cloud 

GCP 

AI-driven engineering 

Claude Code, Codex 

Collaboration & design 

Jira, Confluence, Figma 

What we offer: 

  • Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment. 

  • Our “Remote Policy” helps you find the right balance between onsite and remote work. 

  • Day-to-day benefits including CSE benefits, luncheon vouchers, profit-sharing bonuses and weekly sport sessions organized by TrainMe. 

Recruitment process: 

  1. Interview with a TA team member — 30–45 minutes. 

  1. Interview with the Head of Architecture — 1 hour. 

  1. Case study — 1 hour 30 minutes: model and simplify a sample business domain, then outline how an AI agent could enforce its functional rules. 

  1. Interview with the CTO — 45 minutes.

Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

Not a remote position, presence is required 3x per week in our Paris office.

GTM Systems builds and runs the platform behind Pigment’s go-to-market, from first touch to renewal: Salesforce at the core, and the tools connected to it. 

As our GTM Systems Engineer, you’ll bring an engineering mindset to that platform: how it’s built, how it’s shipped and how it stays secure as Pigment scales, while staying close to the business need behind every change

You’ll report to the GTM Systems Lead and work alongside a Senior GTM Systems Admin. Revenue Operations and Functional Ops are your closest partners, with Growth, Data and IT teams around you.

 

Who will thrive in this role:

  • An engineer at heart: you reach for Apex, LWC or an integration when declarative tools hit their limits, and you write code others can maintain.

  • A delivery-minded builder: you ship through Git and CI/CD, never straight into production, and you want the pipeline to get faster and safer.

  • A security-first architect: you design access, integration users and data flows so that every system writing into Salesforce follows clear rules.

  • A business partner, not a ticket-taker: you want to understand the process before you build it, and you’ll say so when a request doesn’t solve the real problem.

  • An AI builder: you don’t just use AI tools, you want to build agents into GTM processes, and the guardrails that let others build safely.


    • What You’ll Do:

  • Build and improve Salesforce with Flows, Apex and LWC, across the data model, automation and integrations

  • Work with the Ops teams to understand and challenge their needs, and turn them into functional and technical designs: specs, test plans, success criteria and documentation..

  • Ship through our Git-based delivery pipeline, and help make it faster and safer.

  • Build AI agents into the processes you own, and develop the AI skillset and guardrails that let others build safely.

  • Own the security of Salesforce and the tools connected to it: access, permissions, integration users, and clear rules for every system that writes into Salesforce.

  • Run each launch through its first weeks in production, then hand it over to the Ops teams with documentation they will actually use.

  • Pay down technical debt and keep every solution consistent with our architecture.


    • Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience in a B2B SaaS company, with a strong development side.

  • Solid Apex and Flow skills, and experience with LWC and Salesforce integrations.

  • Hands-on experience shipping Salesforce changes through Git-based version control and CI/CD.

  • Deep knowledge of the Salesforce security model (permissions, sharing, integration users) and the judgment to keep it simple.

  • Business curiosity: you want to understand the process before you build, and you’re comfortable challenging a request.

  • A proactive, opinionated approach: you look for better ways of doing things and know how to bring people along.

  • Clear communication in English, written and spoken: you can explain what you built, and why, to non-technical teams.

  • A habit of learning new tools, AI included, and pushing Salesforce further than its defaults.

    Nice to Have:

  • Experience with integration and data tools such as Hightouch, n8n or BigQuery, or with partner and customer success tooling.

  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II a plus).


    • How We Work:
  • Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet
  • Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
  • Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission
  • Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment
  • Champion our Customers: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our Customers heroes in their organizations

    • What we offer:
  • Competitive package
  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family 
  • Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
  • Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
    • We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
     
    Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability,  sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

code.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p> <p><strong><u>À propos de WPP Media :</u></strong></p> <p><strong>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance.</strong> Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie.</p> <p>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing.</p> <p>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents, nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wppmedia.com">www.wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes.</p> <p>Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Être Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li><strong>Créer un environnement Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li><strong>Diriger avec Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Rôle et missions :</u></strong></p> <p>Au sein du <strong>Département Affichage (OOH, DOOH, Événementiel) &amp; Média Local</strong> de WPP Media, vous rejoignez une équipe à taille humaine, experte et passionnée. Rattaché directement au Manager du pôle Études &amp; Marketing, votre rôle est au cœur de la stratégie : faire parler la donnée pour nourrir les recommandations médias, mesurer l'efficacité de nos dispositifs et démontrer le ROI des campagnes de nos annonceurs.</p> <p>En interaction étroite avec les experts trading/achat, les équipes conseil et le pôle Data &amp; Analytics, vos missions s'articulent autour de 4 piliers majeurs :</p> <ol> <li><strong><u>Études de marché, cibles et insights stratégiques :</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Réaliser des piges concurrentielles approfondies et des bilans d’investissements publicitaires à l’aide des outils Kantar (AdExpress).</li> <li>Concevoir et analyser des cibles médias fines via SIMM-TGI afin d’identifier les univers d’affichage prioritaires (transports, mobilier urbain, centres commerciaux, etc.).</li> <li>Participer activement à la préparation des compétitions et pitchs annonceurs en produisant des fiches sectorielles et des analyses de tendances percutantes.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong><u>Mesure de l'efficacité et post-tests de campagnes :</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Être l'interlocuteur du pôle Data &amp; Analytics pour co-développer et déployer les études d’impact et de branding (post-tests).</li> <li>Piloter l'ensemble du process : cadrage des besoins, activation des panels, analyse des performances et coordination du modèle de co-financement avec les régies publicitaires.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong><u>Accompagnement Géomarketing &amp; Campagnes Locales :</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Exploiter l'outil propriétaire de géomarketing pour extraire des indicateurs territoriaux et des insights clés au service des stratégies locales de nos clients.</li> <li>Contribuer à enrichir et optimiser les bases de données de nos outils métiers.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong><u>Pédagogie &amp; Valorisation du Média :</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Contribuer à la mise à jour des présentations de référence du département et des modules de formation interne (Media Academy).</li> <li>Assurer une veille active sur les innovations du secteur (digitalisation de l'affichage / DOOH, data, IA, nouveaux formats).</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Profil Recherché :</u></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong><u>Formation :</u></strong> De formation Bac+4/5 (École de commerce, Université ou équivalent) avec une spécialisation en Marketing, Études, Statistiques ou Communication / Média.</li> <li><strong><u>Expérience </u>:</strong> Vous justifiez d'une <strong>première expérience réussie (stage de fin d'études ou alternance)</strong> au sein d'une agence média (pôle études, marketing ou trading) ou en régie publicitaire (idéalement affichage OOH/DOOH).</li> <li><strong><u>Compétences techniques :</u></strong></li> <li>Maîtrise des outils Kantar indispensables au poste : <strong>AdExpress</strong> et <strong>SIMM-TGI</strong>.</li> <li>Connaissance ou notions de la méthodologie <strong>Mobimétrie</strong>.</li> <li>Maîtrise avancée d'<strong>Excel</strong> (tableaux croisés dynamiques, formules complexes, synthèse de données) et de <strong>PowerPoint</strong> (restitution visuelle et storytelling de la data).</li> <li><strong><u>Compétences relationnelles &amp; comportementales :</u></strong></li> <li><strong>Fort esprit d’analyse et de synthèse :</strong> vous savez transformer la donnée chiffrée brute en recommandations business claires et actionnables.</li> <li><strong>Rigueur et précision :</strong> vous êtes garant de la fiabilité des chiffres et de la qualité des livrables.</li> <li><strong>Curiosité intellectuelle :</strong> vous vous intéressez aux nouveaux modes de consommation média, à la data et à l’intelligence artificielle.</li> <li><strong>Esprit d’équipe et aisance relationnelle :</strong> vous aimez collaborer au quotidien avec des profils complémentaires (consultants DTA, traders média, planneurs stratégiques).</li> <li><strong>Langues :</strong> Anglais professionnel opérationnel (niveau B2 minimum souhaité, particulièrement à l'écrit pour la documentation et les études groupe).</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :</u></strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p><strong>Nos avantages comprennent :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Télétravail :</strong> jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année.</li> <li><strong>Congés offerts :</strong> 2 jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte.</li> <li><strong>Ancienneté :</strong> Jours de congé additionnels par palier de 5 ans d’ancienneté.</li> <li><strong>Santé &amp; Équité :</strong> 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaboratrices souffrant d’endométriose.</li> <li><strong>Politique handicap :</strong> 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH.</li> <li><strong>Engagement sociétal :</strong> Missions solidaires possibles via le programme <em>We care and we act</em>.</li> <li><strong>Tools :</strong> Accès à des outils performants et à la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes et le reporting (WPP Open).</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Process de recrutement :</u></strong></p> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process :</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien avec l’équipe Recrutement :</strong> Un premier échange téléphonique ou par visioconférence avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition pour faire connaissance, aborder votre parcours et vos motivations.</li> <li><strong>Entretien opérationnel &amp; Étude de cas :</strong> Une rencontre avec le Manager du pôle Études &amp; Marketing, accompagnée d'un <strong>Business Case</strong> concret permettant d'évaluer votre logique analytique et votre capacité de restitution.</li> <li><strong>Entretien de Direction :</strong> Un échange final avec la Directrice du pôle.</li> </ol> <p><em>Au moins l'une des étapes du process se déroulera en présentiel dans nos locaux).</em></p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.<br><br>#<span class="mark75646pde3" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="" data-ogsbtc="" data-ogsbrc="" data-ogsbbc="" data-ogsblc="">LI</span>-<span class="markjbl5iys92" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="" data-ogsbtc="" data-ogsbrc="" data-ogsbbc="" data-ogsblc="">Promoted</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Your mission is to evolve existing report processing, storage, and APIs into a shared service, so teams can submit work, process findings, and retrieve reusable artifacts and evidence without rebuilding these capabilities independently. Shape the service around static and agentic workflows, with support for additional analysis types guided by validated customer needs. The domain covers issue-processing pipelines, durable storage, and supporting APIs and events. You will agree the scope and ownership of shared execution orchestration and other expanded capabilities with engine, infrastructure, and consuming-product teams. Engine teams retain detection logic; consuming teams retain their product workflows and acceptance criteria; workflow and Quality Gate owners retain publication, policy, and merge decisions. Your direct customers are the technical teams building analysis engines, agent services, guidance capabilities, and other products on this service. Shape a multi-year plan across customer value, dependencies, technical debt, adoption, and cost. Align senior leaders on trade-offs and recommend where to increase, redirect, or stop investment as evidence changes. Lead discovery with analysis-engine, agent-service, and consuming-product teams, and customers integrating through APIs. Use customer evidence and market and ecosystem signals to identify shared needs and opportunities for differentiation. Coordinate validation across ambiguous, interdependent initiatives. Support different execution environments rather than require every engine to run in one place. Lead product discovery for issue-processing pipelines, including ingestion, normalization, correlation, deduplication, and tracking findings across code changes. Agree contracts for issue identity and state changes with engine and workflow owners, keeping processing separate from publication and policy decisions. Define how source context, findings, execution traces, proposed fixes, and verification results are stored, connected, discovered, and reused. Make freshness, provenance, coverage, and verification limits explicit so missing or incomplete checks are never treated as passes. Guide investments in shared APIs, events, extensibility, documentation, and integration paths. Reduce engine and consumer onboarding effort and enable independent delivery through stable, versioned contracts. Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and security on reliability, scalability, tenant isolation, access control, retention, and observability. Prove value through complete customer workflows before generalizing, and resolve cross-team dependencies without compromising reliability or compatibility. Shape launch, onboarding, and enablement for significant domain releases. Align leaders on evaluation evidence, fallback behavior, human controls, and cost and latency limits, while consuming teams retain their product-specific acceptance criteria. Lead product decisions from incident learning and establish responsible AI-enabled working practices across the domain. Build domain-wide measurement and experimentation practices. Track integration effort, time to useful results, evidence reuse, reliability, and cost per workflow, connecting these measures to customer and business outcomes. Experience and qualifications A sustained track record of shaping strategy and delivering measurable outcomes across multiple related technical product areas, particularly developer platforms, APIs, distributed services, workflow orchestration, or data-processing systems. Strong technical foundations, ideally developed through software engineering or a similarly hands-on role. You can read code, explore APIs, interpret traces, and build small prototypes to test assumptions. Fluency in asynchronous and event-driven systems, queues, durable execution, data models, API versioning, and failure handling. You can discuss architectural trade-offs credibly without taking design ownership away from engineering. An understanding of software development workflows, including repositories, branches and commits, builds, CI/CD, testing, and how analysis findings are investigated and resolved. Practical understanding of AI-agent workflows and their operational implications, including tool execution, nondeterministic outcomes, context reuse, verification, and cost controls. Strong strategic product judgment backed by discovery, market insight, and validation experience. raw.title: AI Systems Engineer
raw.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.


What you will do

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

  • Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

  • Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

  • Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

  • Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

  • Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

  • Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead


    • Experience and qualifications

    Experience & Technical Acumen

  • AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

  • Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

  • Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

  • Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

  • CMDB / Asset Management: Experience configuring and maintaining a CMDB or IT asset management system (JSM Assets, ServiceNow CMDB, or equivalent).

  • ITSM & ITIL Knowledge: Strong understanding of ITSM processes and ITIL v3/v4 frameworks — including incident, change, problem, and request management — with the ability to configure platform workflows that enforce these processes at scale.

  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), access governance, and audit-readiness requirements. Experience supporting external audit engagements is a plus.

  • Atlassian Certifications (Plus): ACP-620 (Jira Service Management), ACP-120 (Jira Administrator), or ACP-420 (Confluence Administrator) are highly valued.

    • Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities — you see patterns others miss and turn complexity into clean solutions.

  • Highly autonomous and pragmatic: you make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect information, without waiting for perfect requirements.

  • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize across competing demands and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo — and to give and receive direct feedback in the service of continuous improvement.

  • Excellent communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English, written and verbal.

  • Collaborative by nature: you share information and ideas freely, and you understand that the best solutions emerge from collective thinking.

  • Leadership mindset: you take ownership of initiatives end-to-end and drive them to completion with accountability and autonomy.

  • Values "done" over "perfect" — while continuously looking for ways to improve processes and deliver measurable impact.

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
description: Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness. As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers. Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production. This role is for you if… you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk. This role isn't for you if… your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start. Key Responsibilities Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach. Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces. Ensure electrical safety through the design on both the medium-voltage and low-voltage side: creepage and clearance distances, CTI and material selection, electrical isolation and sealing. Design for manufacturing, assembly and test from the first concept, working with suppliers on processes such as injection molding, sheet metal and machining. Own the DFMEA for your designs and drive the resulting actions into the design. Validate designs with structural FEA, including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis, before they are released for production, and correlate the results with test data. Build and assemble prototypes and test assemblies hands-on in our workshop, together with the engineering team, using additive manufacturing where it speeds things up. Collaborate with other engineers to take designs from concept through prototype to series production. Share your expertise and support other engineers on best practices in mechanical engineering. Qualifications Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field. 4+ years of full-time industry experience in mechanical design, with a focus on the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems. Proven experience applying DFM and DFA to your own designs, with parts and assemblies that made it into production. Hands-on experience leading or actively contributing to DFMEAs. Strong experience with structural FEA (e.g. ANSYS), including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis. You set up the models yourself and use the results to drive design decisions. Solid knowledge of creepage, clearance, CTI, insulation coordination and electrical safety (e.g. IEC 60664-1, IEC 62477-1), ideally up to medium voltage. Solid experience designing with polymers/plastics, ideally for electronics integration. Proficiency in 3D CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis. Hands-on experience building and assembling prototypes in a professional setting. Experience with environmental, reliability and safety standards for power delivery products. Basic understanding of electrical design fundamentals; familiarity with PCBAs and PCBA components. Strong organization, written and verbal communication skills. Fluent English; German is a plus. Eligible to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit). The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland. Nice to Have Experience with industrialization: taking hardware from prototype to series production and designing with series production in mind from the start (tooling such as injection molds, supplier involvement, cost and process capability). Experience with high-volume manufacturing and automated assembly processes. Experience with additive manufacturing (e.g. SLA, SLS, FDM) for prototypes, fixtures and jigs, ideally including insulating or flame-retardant materials. Experience with PFMEA, DFT and DFR. Experience with insulation design for medium voltage, including partial discharge. Experience with liquid cooling integration or CFD. Benefits Equity + competitive salary. Unique technology and market opportunity – design the hardware of a new product category for the energy transition. Hybrid work with flexible working times.
