description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital. Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Summary of Position:

The Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader, reporting to the Vice President Global Medical Affairs, will lead the development and execution of the go-to market strategy and deliverables to support value of apitegromab as well as the clinical stage Scholar Rock portfolio, in close partnership with the cross-functional matrix team. 

This individual will serve as the strategic leader and subject matter expert for EMEA HEOR, responsible for country-level budget impact and cost-effectiveness model adaptations, evidence generation plans, and value communications required to support the national health technology assessment (HTA), payer dossiers, EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA), and reimbursement negotiations of Scholar Rock treatments. The role requires strong strategic leadership and cross-functional collaboration with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Clinical Development and the regional teams in EMEA to optimize access and reimbursement for patients worldwide. 

The successful candidate will develop strategic partnerships and research collaborations with external experts, healthcare policymakers, payers and various academic centers to support the strategy for apitegromab and future products. 


Position Responsibilities
  • Develop HEOR strategies for EMEA, with an emphasis on Europe, that support product value demonstration, reimbursement, market access, and launch objectives.
  • Lead the design, implementation, and oversight of HEOR studies, models, and deliverables for Europe.
  • Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, and Biostatistics to determine real-world evidence needs for payers in Europe—including registries, natural history and external control analyses, burden of illness, treatment patterns, resource use, and addressing evidence requirements arising in HTA appraisal and reimbursement negotiations.
  • Incorporate evidence gaps needed for European payers into evidence generation plans
  • Direct evidence synthesis and value communication for payer and HTA bodies.
  • Serve as Europe HEOR partner to Europe Market Access for access and reimbursement dossiers by providing country-specific adaptations of models, methodology guidance, and scientific reviews that support country-level deliverables.
  • Own the HEOR deliverables for timely submissions to EU JCA, including PICO-driven evidence planning and comparative effectiveness analyses.
  • Work closely across Global HEOR and cross-functional teams to inform endpoint, patient-reported outcome, and utility data collection strategy for clinical development programs so that trials generate evidence acceptable to payers and HTA bodies.
  • Manage external HEOR vendors, budgets, and contracts, ensuring quality and timely delivery across competing priorities.
  • Translate complex HEOR outputs and requirements into plain-language value narratives for internal leadership and external payers.

    • Candidate Requirements
  • Graduate degree in health economics, epidemiology, health services research, or another research-focused public health discipline
  • 8+ years of HEOR experience with an MSc/MPH, or 5+ years with a PhD
  • Extensive experience leading HEOR evidence generation to support HTA submissions across multiple markets in Europe
  • Direct experience engaging with HTA organizations in Europe
  • Working knowledge of EU HTA regulations and Joint Clinical Assessment process
  • Experience developing or adapting budget-impact and cost-effectiveness models
  • Experience conducted indirect treatment comparisons or network meta-analysis
  • Strong track record of managing vendors
  • Ability to influence cross-functional and regional stakeholders without direct authority
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Prior experience in neuromuscular disease and/or rare diseases is preferred but not required.
  • ~15% travel, ability to work across global time zones

title: Platform Engineer
description: Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer . Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform. Jouw rol Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten. Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting. Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties. Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden. Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht. Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform. Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.   Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau . Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code . Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie: Je versterkt een snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met een sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie: Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact: Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met een directe en tastbare maatschappelijke impact. Salaris: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €7.500,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om goed uit te rusten en op te laden. Werkplek & Sfeer: Een gezellige werksfeer op ons kantoor in Hilversum met flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor. Mobiliteit & Fiets: Een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km of een volledige OV-vergoeding, én een fiscaal aantrekkelijk fietsplan. Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen voor jouw toekomst. Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor het volgen van opleidingen en trainingen om te blijven groeien, plus een jaarlijks Coolblue thuiswerkbudget van € 500,- om je werkplek perfect in te richten. Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er toe doen. Denk aan de zorg, educatie, duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud. We bouwen software die logisch voelt. We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Director to lead public sector sales initiatives across the DACH region. In this role, you will drive the adoption of innovative AI-powered intelligence solutions that help government agencies investigate financial crime, disrupt illicit activities, and strengthen security. You will manage the entire sales cycle, from identifying new opportunities and building strategic relationships to negotiating and closing complex, high-value deals. Working with public sector stakeholders, senior executives, and internal teams, you will develop tailored commercial strategies that address customer needs and deliver measurable value. Your key responsibilities will include: Map and develop relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers across public sector accounts in the DACH region. Identify and engage new prospects to expand market presence and generate qualified business opportunities. Manage the full sales lifecycle, from initial prospecting and relationship development to negotiations and closing high-value deals. Develop and execute strategic account and territory plans aligned with commercial objectives and customer priorities. Lead customer engagement initiatives, including relationship nurturing, feedback collection, referrals, renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion. Build strong product and industry expertise to communicate the value of AI-powered intelligence solutions and address the specific needs of public sector customers. Deliver compelling presentations and value propositions that demonstrate how solutions can help customers investigate and disrupt criminal activities. Act as a customer advocate by gathering feedback, identifying customer needs, and communicating insights to relevant internal teams. Develop a network of satisfied customers who can provide referrals, champion the solutions, and contribute valuable product feedback. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to coordinate sales activities and deliver a consistent customer experience. Requirements : The ideal candidate is a consultative sales professional with a strong track record of selling SaaS solutions to public sector organizations across the DACH market. You should be comfortable navigating complex procurement processes, engaging senior decision-makers, and managing strategic opportunities with significant commercial value. The following qualifications are expected: At least 5 years of experience selling SaaS products to public sector accounts in the DACH region. Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and successfully close high-value, six- and seven-figure deals. Strong customer-facing presentation and active listening skills, with the ability to establish credibility and build relationships with senior executives. Excellent storytelling abilities and the capacity to translate customer challenges into compelling value propositions. Strong understanding of consultative selling, account management, prospecting, and strategic territory planning. Knowledge of the cryptocurrency ecosystem and an interest in blockchain-related technologies, financial crime investigation, or digital asset intelligence. Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities, evolving customer needs, and dynamic market conditions. High degree of autonomy, accountability, and ownership of commercial outcomes. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative approach to working across teams. Benefits: Remote-first working environment within an international and distributed team. Competitive compensation package. High degree of autonomy and ownership over strategic accounts and commercial initiatives. Opportunity to work on innovative AI-powered technology at the intersection of cryptocurrency, national security, and financial crime prevention. This role is focused on delivering a secure, reliable and consistent macOS experience at scale through Jamf Pro, reusable code, APIs and modern engineering practices. 
 
You will replace repetitive administration and one-off scripts with maintainable automation for device enrolment, configuration, application delivery, patching, compliance and lifecycle management. Working across Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, identity, security, asset and service-management platforms, you will build integrations and workflows that make Apple device services easier to operate, measure and support. 
 

Engineering mindset 
Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a manual Jamf task, fragile policy or recurring Mac support issue and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?” 

You should be comfortable working from Apple and Jamf documentation, investigating unfamiliar behaviours and translating operational requirements into production-quality automation. Your solutions account for failure, test changes before release, scale to an enterprise environment, provide useful telemetry and favour reusable frameworks over isolated scripts. You take ownership from design through operation, document your work and balance long-term platform improvements with immediate business needs. 
 
What success looks like 
You will measurably reduce manual effort, deployment lead time and configuration drift across the macOS estate. Enrollment, configuration, software delivery, patching, security compliance and device lifecycle processes will become increasingly automated, observable, auditable and recoverable. 
 
Over time, you will establish a scalable Apple endpoint automation model based on Jamf Pro, APIs, version-controlled code, release pipelines and shared engineering standards rather than manual platform administration. 


What you'll do

macOS Platform & Jamf Automation 

  • Design and maintain automation for macOS enrolment, provisioning, configuration, application delivery, updates and device retirement using Jamf Pro. 

  • Build reusable scripts, tools and workflows using shell scripting, Python, Jamf APIs and other appropriate technologies.

Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je onderzoek ook tijd zult besteden aan andere zaken in onze farm. Dit geldt niet alleen voor jou als stagiair maar voor ons hele team. Zo draait iedereen uit kantoor maandelijks een shift in de farm, waarbij we helpen met zaaien, oogsten of verpakken. 🌱 Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Een unieke stageplek; wij bouwen aan de toekomst van voedselproductie; Je wordt onderdeel van een klein team, er wordt naar je ideëen en input geluisterd; We werken fulltime vanaf onze farm in Amsterdam; Een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van 500 euro, we vergoeden geen andere zaken; Veel ruimte en tijd voor creativiteit en een ‘ga het maar proberen!' mentaliteit Een gezellige werksfeer waarin we graag samen na werk nog leuke dingen ondernemen 🌱 Wat breng jij? Je volgt een HBO of WO opleiding in Nederland en staat daar ingeschreven gedurende de hele stage periode. Qua studies denken wij in de richting marketing, bedrijfskunde of (commerciële) psychologie, maar wie weet volg jij een andere studie die ook goed aansluit 🙂 Fulltime beschikbaar voor 4 of 5 maanden, startdatum december 2026 of januari of februari 2027 Je hebt je rijbewijs B; je zult veel op pad zijn om supermarkten te bezoeken Een flinke portie nieuwsgierigheid Je bent sociaal; je stapt makkelijk op mensen af en maakt een praatje met ze Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je ook goed redden in het Engels Je bent een zelf-starter; we zullen je uiteraard begeleiden tijdens je stage, maar het initiatief voor de invulling en aanpak ligt bij jou Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager Insurance P&C
description: Insify is looking for a smart, ambitious and relentlessly driven Insurance Product Manager to join our team. In this role you’ll be a driving force behind our product expansions and building the digital platform for SME insurance. A rare opportunity to take real ownership in a fast-scaling European insurtech and shape outcomes that matter. At Insify, we build insurance for entrepreneurs because we are entrepreneurs ourselves. We know what it’s like to build something from scratch, to take risks, and to carry responsibility that doesn’t switch off at 5 pm. Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make business insurance 10x simpler, faster, and fairer for entrepreneurs and SMEs across Europe . No paperwork. No fine print. No legacy complexity. Just modern software, smart automation, and a relentless focus on the customer. We are a high-growth European scale-up , backed by €43M from world-class investors , on a mission to become a global leader in digital insurance for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Starting in the Netherlands, we’ve expanded into France and Germany, and we’re only accelerating from here. At our core, we’re a tech company . We build our own insurtech platform and rely heavily on data, automation, and AI to redesign the end-to-end insurance experience:  from underwriting to claims. Combined with a fully digital customer portal and strong UX, we’re turning insurance into something surprisingly simple, transparent, and fair. We’re led by seasoned entrepreneurs who’ve built and scaled companies before, and we bring that same ambition, urgency, and ownership mindset to everything we do. What you'll be doing: Insify is looking for an entrepreneurial and analytical Product Manager to drive the growth and evolution of our Property & Casualty (P&C) portfolio . This role focuses on the essential "bread and butter" products for SMEs: including General Liability, Professional Indemnity, and Property insurance. Unlike traditional PM roles, you won't just be managing features; you will be the "CEO" of your products. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers. This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance. What you’ll be up to (some examples): Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online. Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates. Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform. Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution. Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy. This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next. Specifically, you bring: 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred). Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions. Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance. Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting." Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint). Educational Background: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field. Who this is not for: You prioritize a 40-hour work week : We operate in a high-intensity 'startup-plus' environment. This isn't a standard 9-to-5; driving global impact here requires a level of dedication and 'always-on' spirit that goes well beyond the typical 40-hour work week. You prefer your comfort zone : We operate at the edge of our capabilities; if you aren't comfortable with constant change and being challenged, you won’t thrive here. You prefer to stay high-level : While this is a strategic role, no task is too small. If you aren't willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the "weeds" of execution, this isn't the right fit. A steep learning curve feels daunting : We move fast and use cutting-edge AI; you need to be an aggressive self-learner who can master new domains in days, not months. What we offer: Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that. In-office - come join us in our HQ in the center of Amsterdam. Grow in a growing company - there’s no better place to develop your talents and learn new skills. Help us show the world that insurance can be simple, transparent and trustworthy. Experienced entrepreneurs - work with experienced and dedicated entrepreneurs as part of an international team. Energetic environment - as a start-up, we’re different from your usual insurers. We scale rapidly and you can pick your own initiatives, helping us grow as we help more and more customers across Europe. Our culture (read this carefully) We’re not just building a company, we’re building a  category leader . That comes with ambition, responsibility, and pace. Our culture is defined by three things: High ownership People own problems end-to-end. If something is unclear or broken, we don’t wait - we step in and fix it. High pace Priorities shift, and decisions are made quickly. We value momentum and learning over perfection. High standards Outcomes matter more than optics. We care about results, quality, and follow-through. At the same time, you won’t be doing this alone . We believe great work happens through close collaboration . We work in-person, challenge each other’s ideas, and expect contributions from everywhere, regardless of title or tenure. The best ideas often come from unexpected places, and we create space for them to surface. This is a human-sized company . You’ll know the people you work with, you’ll be able to walk over to anyone to ask a question or test an idea, and you’ll be part of the day-to-day energy of building together:  from whiteboard discussions to shared lunches, dogs in the office, and moments to pause and reset. We hire smart, ambitious people who think like owners, value intellectual honesty, and are motivated by impact rather than comfort. If you enjoy challenge, responsibility, and building something meaningful with others, you’ll likely thrive here. If you’re looking for predictability, narrow scopes, or a guaranteed 9-to-5, this likely won’t be the right fit - and that’s okay. We’d rather be honest upfront. raw.description:
About Insify

We are a start-up offering an end-to-end digital insurance platform focussing solely on European entrepreneurs and SMEs. We offer the best insurance to our customers thanks to our focus on user experience, our leading underwriting services, and our expertise in data. In short, we’ve made getting insured quick, transparent and simple.

We know how to innovate - our team of seasoned entrepreneurs has built a host of successful businesses in fintech and e-commerce (HelloFresh, Bloomon and SumUp to name a few!).We’ve already raised over €25M in funding from leading investors (Accel Ventures, Frontline Ventures, Visionaries Club, Nico Rosberg, etc.), who love what we do and see the potential for a revolution in digital insurance.

We started our journey in the Netherlands and with our mission to make business insurance fast, simple and fair we have been able to have a significant impact on that market. Since last year we also serve customers in France and Germany, and are rapidly expanding across the rest of Europe!

How we work

At Insify, we’re building more than just an insurance company—we’re creating a culture that’s bold, caring, and built to make a real difference. Everything we do is driven by our core values: grit, impact, care, and entrepreneurship.

We show up with passion and perseverance. We solve real problems and put people first—especially our customers. And we’re always looking for smarter, faster, more human ways to do things.

That’s also why we’ve chosen a pro-office approach. We believe that working together, face to face, sparks creativity, builds stronger teams, and helps us learn faster—especially for new joiners. From spontaneous brainstorms to shared lunches, being in the same space makes the magic happen.

Joining Insify means being part of a team that truly backs each other and the entrepreneurs we serve. If you’re ready to grow, innovate, and help reshape the insurance industry from the inside out—we’d love to meet you.

Insurance Team

We’re the team making insurance work for everyone and everything. At Insify, our Insurance crew is all about making sure the right coverages are available, affordable, and actually make sense for today’s entrepreneurs. We’re the bridge between customer needs and carrier capabilities—constantly exploring, negotiating, and building better insurance solutions.

From partnering with top carriers to developing our own products, we ensure our platform delivers complete, seamless coverage. Whether it’s a roofer in Rotterdam or a freelance designer in Berlin, we’re here to make sure no one’s left out. Our team includes insurance pros, actuaries, and product ops experts working hand-in-hand with product, legal, and compliance to reshape insurance from the inside out.

About the Role
 
This is your chance to work in a dynamic company where innovation and precision go hand in hand to disrupt the insurance industry. You'll be part of our Insurance team, as lead to ensure the scalability and sustainability of our portfolio optimizing both the bottom and top lines.
 
We are a data-driven company and we don’t lose time on tasks with little to no value therefore, on top of modeling the risk, price elasticity, customer lifetime value, and other key business drivers and trends, you will also be supporting the full End-to-end automation, set up of proper data flows, tooling and overall pricing platform solution.

What you will be doing

raw.description:
About the role

At SkyNRG, we’re on a mission leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high‑integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). Our Innovation team plays a key role in this mission by scouting, assessing and developing technologies that can scale SAF production and strengthen the industry’s sustainability performance.

As an Intern within the Innovation team, you will perform research focused on the sustainability performance of innovative technology routes to SAF. During this internship, you will build a framework for Life Cycle Analysis of various SAF production routes and evaluate the GHG reduction potential and fit with European Policy frameworks for selected routes. You will work closely with a technically skilled and experienced Innovation team and report directly to our Senior Analyst, Dusita de Hoop.

This internship offers the opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a real‑world context, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovation at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Life Cycle Assessment: Build a framework to assess life cycle performance of various innovative SAF production routes.

  • GHG reduction calculation: Calculate the GHG reduction potential of selected SAF production routes

  • Policy Fit: asses the fit of selected SAF production routes with European SAF policy such as REFUELEU Aviation.

  • Team collaboration: Work closely with external partners, contributing findings, insights and ideas to ongoing research and development activities.

Your profile

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • Master’s student with a background in science or engineering (enrolled for the full duration of the internship)

  • Strong interest in renewable fuels, energy transition or sustainable technologies

  • Experience or academic exposure with Life Cycle Analysis and GHG reduction calculations is a must. Able to work independently, strong analytical skillset and a structured approach to complex technical questions

  • Comfortable working with Excel, Word and PowerPoint

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

  • Full-time availability for a 6-month internship starting 15th of February 2027

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

  • An inspiring international work environment in a fast-growing and innovative industry.

  • A great opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary, committed, and talented team.

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office/remote) working arrangements.

  • Commuting travel reimbursement.

  • Paid Volunteering Day.

  • Access to our electric company boat, free lunches, and social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

📌 Please note: We do not accept sales inquiries or intermediary services.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Backend Platform (PHP and Python)
description: WHO WE ARE 🌍 Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does. Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work. We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟 Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it? We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best. Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading. YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋 Meet the Backend Platform team: We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀 Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python. Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system. Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time. Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each. Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact. Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing. Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation. Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team. Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date. Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants. Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components. TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥 You'll need: Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both. Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance. Experience designing multi-component systems with clear boundaries, planning for failures, rollout, and rollback, with security in mind. Experience comparing technical options, naming the trade-offs, and explaining your choice in writing (ADRs, Design Docs). Hands-on observability experience: metrics, dashboards, alerts, logs, and distributed tracing, and using them to find root causes. Experience leading a project that spans several teams: breaking it into small, testable steps, getting other teams on board, and taking it to production. A track record of improving engineering quality beyond your own tasks, for example setting up error monitoring, or a new process when things kept breaking. Enough infrastructure knowledge (databases, servers, proxies, DNS) to work well with Infra and see how your changes affect them. Clear communication: you explain your point of view, find the real problem behind a request, and flag risks early. Experience leading work independently while supporting your team: taking feedback, helping colleagues grow, and changing your mind when the arguments are good. It would be great if you have: Experience on a Platform or Core team. Strong production experience in both PHP and Python. Experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, JWT or Ory Oathkeeper). Experience defining SLOs and building symptom-based alerts. Experience running incidents and blameless post-mortems. Experience with Grafana Cloud, Rollbar, or similar tools. Experience building developer tooling, CI/CD, or tools for AI coding assistants. Experience mentoring engineers or leading knowledge sharing across teams. WHAT WE OFFER 🤗 We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort: 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family. 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family. 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow. 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office. 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota. 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks. 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events. 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance. This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. title: Senior Engineering Manager
description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options. Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time. You won’t do it alone. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, EAP and CT Operations, and our Platform colleagues in DevOps, Security and Data. Together, you’ll turn ambitious company goals into product outcomes that make a real difference in patients’ lives. Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam. What you’ll do in this role: Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture. Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production. Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements. Provide technical leadership in architecture and design, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, scalable and secure. Work with engineers on decisions about tools, frameworks and approaches. Champion engineering best practices: proactive exploration AI-enabled and agentic development, code quality, testing, code review, API design, observability, documentation and secure development. Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare. Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives. Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent. What you bring to the table: A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development. 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams. A proven track record of delivering high-quality web products and developing engineers. Hands-on familiarity with modern backend and frontend technologies. Experience with Python and Angular is a plus. A strong understanding of Agile ways of working, product development and engineering best practices. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels. A passion for working in a mission-driven organisation focused on improving patient outcomes. Experience in a regulated domain such as healthcare or life sciences or in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, is a plus. What success looks like in the first 6 months: You’ve built trust within your team and with Product, Design and Operations, and established clear ownership across your areas of the EAP and CT platforms. Delivery is predictable and transparent. The team ships valuable increments regularly, with a clear link to product goals. Code quality, test coverage and release reliability are visibly improving. Every team member has clear expectations and a development plan, and you’ve addressed any key gaps in team composition. The team works with autonomy and accountability, and collaborates well with Platform and other engineering teams. You’ve identified and started executing key technical or organisational improvements that enhance scalability and team effectiveness. You’re seen as a trusted technical and people leader, balancing strategic direction with hands-on support where needed. Our current tech stack: We are fully cloud-native on AWS. We follow a lean, API-first product development approach. Our platform services, both microservices and AI, are built in Python. Our frontends are built with Angular. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD to EKS and Terraform for IaC, with staging/production parity, continuous deployment and Grafana for observability. Security is built in through managed secrets, SSO, dependency scanning, end-to-end encryption and periodic pen-tests. Equal opportunities myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

System Engineer – Machine Control
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience

About us
AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing.

The role
You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system.

You will:

  • Own the system control architecture: machine software, control hardware, timing and synchronization, and the data path from acquisition to reconstruction

  • Translate system performance and throughput goals into requirements for control, software and compute, and keep them traceable

  • Own the timing, throughput and data budgets, and decide where time is won or lost in a measurement

  • Define and guard the interfaces between control software, hardware and algorithms, including the hardware abstraction layer

  • Define how the machine is operated: machine states, sequencing, recipes, error handling, logging and monitoring

  • Steer the software and embedded engineers on the control side: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve trade-offs

  • Set up integration and verification of the control layer, with a test strategy that keeps it reliable as the hardware changes between builds

  • Carry the machine software from lab prototype toward a production tool that runs unattended in a fab

Your profile

  • 8+ years in high-tech equipment, including several years as a system engineer, software architect or control architect for a complex machine

  • Experience with machine control in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments

  • Hands-on understanding of real-time and deterministic systems: hardware triggering, FPGA-based synchronization, motion control and high-rate data acquisition

  • Strong in equipment software architecture: layered designs, hardware abstraction, state machines and concurrency

  • Comfortable reading code and reviewing designs in Python and C/C++. You won’t write most of the code, but you can.

  • Strong in requirements, budgets and interface management across hardware and software

  • This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid, and you are as likely to be at the lab bench debugging a trigger as in a design review.

  • A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

  • Taking machine software from prototype to production, including SEMI standards for equipment communication and automation (such as SECS/GEM) and machine safety

  • Integration with wafer handling and factory automation

  • High-throughput data pipelines or GPU computing

  • Experience with optical or imaging systems: cameras, lasers, image data

  • Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools

We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was software architect, control architect or lead engineer, but you have owned how a complex machine runs, apply anyway.

What we offer

  • Shared technical leadership of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

  • Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

  • Competitive salary for the Dutch market

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄

We’re expanding into the Netherlands – and you could be one of our very first team members!

We are looking for a Digital Account Manager who combines hands-on campaign expertise, outstanding client communication, and an AI-first mindset.

This is a highly client-facing role: you will work closely with our Performance and Paid Marketing teams, who handle most of the set-up and monitoring, and be ready to set up campaigns end-to-end and optimize them where needed and, above all, be the trusted point of contact for our clients throughout the whole campaign journey.

You will own the operational execution and performance success of digital campaigns for our clients in the Netherlands, from the internal and client kickoff through optimization to periodic performance evaluations.

The role goes well beyond campaign set-up: you will keep clients informed proactively, turn performance data into clear and convincing stories, and use AI, to work smarter, faster and with better insights.

Your work directly impacts campaign performance, client satisfaction, and long-term customer partnerships.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

  • Client Communication & Relationship Management
    • Be the main point of contact for your clients: communicate consistently and proactively about progress, results and next steps
    • Run periodic evaluations with the client, translating performance into clear insights and recommendations

  • Campaign Set-up & Coordination
    • Lead the internal and client kickoffs, coordinate content with all stakeholders and supervise the respective Performance and Paid Marketing teams in setting up campaigns, stepping in to do the full set-up yourself when necessary
    • Collaborate closely with Sales, Client teams and internal stakeholders to ensure campaign success and delivery on time
  • Optimization & Performance
    • Optimize campaigns where needed, turning data into concrete actions to achieve the best possible results for the client
    • Monitor and analyze performance, and manage campaign tracking, reporting and performance dashboards across formats, in coordination with the Performance and Paid Marketing teams
  • Reports, Presentations & Sales Support
    • Create reports and presentations for your clients, from regular performance updates to periodic evaluations
    • Support the Sales team in creating decks for their proposals
  • AI-Powered Ways of Working
    • Use AI tools, in particular Claude, to generate reports and presentations, analyze performance and streamline your daily workflow
    • Identify opportunities to improve and scale campaign processes through AI and automation
  • Collaboration & Administration
    • Work closely with international colleagues, with English as the language of collaboration
    • Handle client invoicing

WHAT YOU WILL NEED🪄

  • Experience: 2–5 years in digital marketing, campaign management, or account management, ideally in an agency or international environment.
  • Client Communication: Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach. You feel at ease being the main point of contact, translating data into clear insights and building trusted relationships.
  • AI Proficiency: Confident in using AI in your daily work, in particular Claude for generating reports and insights, and curious to keep exploring new ways to work smarter.
  • Coordination & Organization: Strong coordination skills, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders at once.
  • Optimization & Data Mindset: Curious about data, with a drive to achieve the best results for the client and the ability to make data-driven decisions.
  • Digital Expertise: Strong knowledge of digital channels, trends, and tools (CRM systems like HubSpot, analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, Looker; display advertising platforms; Meta Business Suite). Excel or similar skills (Pivot tables) are a must.
  • Campaign Knowledge: Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns, understanding KPIs, and optimizing performance.
  • Languages: Native-level Dutch and fluent spoken English.
  • Mindset: A positive, proactive attitude and the energy to keep campaigns, clients and colleagues moving.

👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

NICE TO HAVE 🎆

  • Comprehensive understanding of retail marketing functions, including budgets, retail purchase cycles, and category-specific user behavior (e.g., FMCG, Grocery, Fashion).

LOCATION 🌐

While you need to be based in the Netherlands, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid or full remote model, empowering you to work where you're most effective.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗

🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

WHO WE ARE 💜

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

You will work across our mobile applications, creating reliable, intuitive and high-performing experiences for patients and healthcare professionals alike. Beyond developing and improving our apps, you will help shape our technical direction, explore new technologies and share your expertise with colleagues. You will have the autonomy to take ownership, make technical decisions and contribute beyond your immediate responsibilities, supported by Luscii's Holacratic way of working. You bring ideas to life, make well-considered technical decisions and help ensure our applications remain performant, stable, scalable and easy to maintain. You will work closely with colleagues across development, QA and support, combining hands-on engineering with technical ownership. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. Together, we build technology that makes healthcare more accessible, giving patients and healthcare professionals more space to focus on care. As a Mobile Developer, you will contribute to this mission by developing and improving the applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

Our digital health solutions enable healthcare professionals to monitor patients remotely, helping people receive the right care in the right place. You will work across our mobile applications, creating reliable, intuitive and high-performing experiences for patients and healthcare professionals alike.

Beyond developing and improving our apps, you will help shape our technical direction, explore new technologies and share your expertise with colleagues. You will have the autonomy to take ownership, make technical decisions and contribute beyond your immediate responsibilities, supported by Luscii's Holacratic way of working.

Your role

As a Mobile Developer at Luscii, you will take ownership of the development, optimisation and maintenance of our mobile applications across iOS and Android. You bring ideas to life, make well-considered technical decisions and help ensure our applications remain performant, stable, scalable and easy to maintain.

You will work closely with colleagues across development, QA and support, combining hands-on engineering with technical ownership. Whether you are building a new feature, exploring a technology through a proof of concept or resolving a production issue, you will help us continuously improve the quality and usability of our digital health solutions.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop, maintain and optimise mobile applications using native technologies such as Kotlin and Swift, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience.

  • Contribute to mobile architecture, technical design and modular codebases, applying clean architecture, object-oriented design principles and patterns such as MVVM and MVI.

  • Build intuitive user interfaces using technologies such as Jetpack Compose and SwiftUI, following platform-specific design guidelines.

  • Develop and maintain features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices, as well as web services, cloud platforms and APIs.

  • Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore new technologies, validate technical approaches and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Investigate and resolve production issues through debugging and performance analysis, covering areas such as memory management, multithreading and networking.

  • Contribute to code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD processes, sharing technical knowledge and helping colleagues make sound implementation decisions.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least five years of experience in mobile development, with a strong background in native Android and/or iOS development. You have extensive experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • You have a relevant bachelor's degree, for example in Computer Science or Computer Engineering and you are familiar with working in an Agile environment.

  • You have a solid understanding of mobile architecture and software design principles, including clean architecture, object-oriented design, MVVM and/or MVI. You know how to build and maintain modular applications.

  • You have experience with mobile development frameworks and tools such as Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow and Kotlin Multiplatform. You are also familiar with unit testing and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and platform-specific design guidelines.

  • You understand what it takes to build reliable, high-performing mobile applications, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation. You have experience integrating web services, cloud technologies, APIs and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!
